items.title_en:
He went on stage with a record player that had the amplifier transistors isolated and proceeded to dominate them into boiling mineral oil.

Here is why…

In May 1954, after rivals claimed heat-proof transistors were impossible, Gordon Teal displayed a record player and a beaker of boiling oil. He spoke at the National Conference on Airborne Electronics in Dayton, Ohio, where the aerospace industry faced a barrier. At the time, commercial transistors relied on germanium. Although germanium had begun replacing bulky vacuum tubes in hearing aids and radios, it failed under heat. Its narrow bandgap meant that once temperatures rose past 65°C (150°F)—conditions common in cockpits, jet engines, and experimental missiles—thermal energy flooded the crystal with loose electrons. The transistor lost its ability to regulate current, making it useless for military avionics.  

The theoretical solution was silicon, whose wider bandgap allowed operation well beyond 150°C. Yet silicon melted at 1,414°C and reacted strongly with nearly any crucible used to melt it. Throughout the conference, representatives from industry leaders such as RCA, General Electric, and Raytheon presented papers explaining why silicon transistors remained years from practical manufacture.  

Then came Gordon Teal, research director of Texas Instruments, then a relatively small Dallas firm known for geophysical oil exploration. Teal had spent months leading a quiet team to refine silicon and grow single crystals using methods he had first developed at Bell Labs.  

Teal took the podium after hearing peers repeat the impossibility of silicon. When his turn arrived, he quietly challenged them, announcing that Texas Instruments already had commercial silicon transistors in production—and that he carried several in his pocket. To support his claim, Teal showed the device on stage. He connected a standard germanium transistor into the amplifier circuit playing music from the record player, then dipped the transistor into a beaker of mineral oil heated to 150°C. The sound stopped immediately. Teal then took out the germanium unit, inserted one of his new silicon transistors, and placed it straight into the hot oil. The record kept playing through the loudspeaker without distortion.  

The display triggered a quick surge. Attendees ran to the lobby payphones to contact their corporate offices and stockbrokers. Texas Instruments representatives distributed specification sheets from the rear of the hall, securing a commercial monopoly on silicon transistors that endured for three years.

The transistor went on to change the world.

items.quote_zh:
他带着一台电唱机走上舞台，电唱机的放大器晶体管被隔离，然后将它们放入沸腾的矿物油中。

这就是为什么……

1954 年 5 月，在竞争对手声称耐热晶体管不可能出现后，戈登·蒂尔展示了一台电唱机和一烧杯沸油。他在俄亥俄州代顿举行的全国机载电子会议上发表了讲话，当时航空航天业在该会议上面临着障碍。当时，商业晶体管依赖于锗。尽管锗已开始取代助听器和收音机中笨重的真空管，但它在高温下失效了。其窄带隙意味着，一旦温度超过 65°C (150°F)（驾驶舱、喷气发动机和实验导弹中常见的情况），热能就会充满松散电子的晶体。晶体管失去了调节电流的能力，使其对军用航空电子设备毫无用处。

理论上的解决方案是硅，其更宽的带隙允许在远高于 150°C 的温度下运行。然而，硅的熔化温度为 1,414°C，几乎与任何用于熔化它的坩埚都会发生强烈反应。在整个会议期间，来自 RCA、通用电气和雷神公司等行业领导者的代表发表了论文，解释了为什么硅晶体管距离实际制造还需要数年时间。

随后是德州仪器 (Texas Instruments) 的研究总监戈登·蒂尔 (Gordon Teal)，当时德州仪器是一家相对较小的达拉斯公司，以地球物理石油勘探而闻名。蒂尔花了几个月的时间带领一支安静的团队使用他在贝尔实验室首次开发的方法来提炼硅并生长单晶。

在听到同行重复硅的不可能性后，蒂尔登上了讲台。当轮到他的时候，他悄悄地向他们发起挑战，宣布德州仪器公司已经在生产商用硅晶体管，而且他口袋里也有几个。为了支持他的主张，蒂尔在舞台上展示了​​该设备。他将一个标准的锗晶体管连接到播放电唱机音乐的放大器电路中，然后将晶体管浸入加热至 150°C 的矿物油烧杯中。声音立刻停止了。然后，蒂尔取出锗单元，插入一个新的硅晶体管，然后将其直接放入热油中。唱片一直通过扬声器播放，没有失真。

显示屏引发了快速的激增。与会者跑到大厅的公用电话联系他们的公司办公室和股票经纪人。德州仪器 (TI) 代表在大厅后部分发规格表，确保了硅晶体管的商业垄断地位并持续了三年。

晶体管继续改变世界。

A recent High Co
items.title_en:
Visionary leadership is about identifying systemic vulnerabilities long before they impact operations.

A recent High Court dispute over the sudden suspension of enterprise software support to a major industrial refiner provided an eye-opening case study in software vendor concentration. While interim court orders directed the resumption of services under domestic law, relying on judicial intervention cannot be a company's only contingency plan.

For corporate leaders and CXOs, this case underscores three clear priorities:
• Review vendor lock-in and mission-critical software dependencies.
• Strengthen contractual terms regarding governing law and unilateral service suspensions.
• Foster and adopt indigenous enterprise solutions to diversify tech risk.

#VisionaryIndians #Leadership #BusinessStrategy #CorporateGovernance #RiskManagement

Its Digital Authority is discussing a sovereign AI Factory with DFINITY, using ICP-based cloud infrastructure to build government software.

Here's the bigger opportunity for $ICP.

Governments increasingly want AI without surrendering control of their data and infrastructure to foreign cloud providers.

But the real victory won't be another agreement. It'll be government applications running in production.

items.title_en:
Given how quickly AI is advancing, I am adding a bunch of super interesting topics to my upcoming Applied AI Cohort 6. Here's a glimpse...

1. How Claude Code Works
2. Jev and Clairic
3. Parallel, Sub, and Long-Running Agents
4. Multi-agent Task Decomposition
5. Production Issues in Multi-Agent Systems
6. Memory Write and Read Paths
7. Agent Reliability
8. Cost Efficiency

Over the last five cohorts, I have continuously refined the content based on feedback, production learnings, and countless technical discussions with participants.

With every cohort, the goal has been to make the content more practical (testimonials reflect the same), relevant, and closer to the problems engineers are solving in the real world.

The goal is simple:

"I know how to call an LLM API" -> "I can design and build production-grade AI systems."

The cohort is extremely practical. We spend very little time on slides and almost all our time reasoning about production problems, writing code, dissecting real systems, discussing trade-offs, and understanding why certain approaches fail in practice.

The focus is on building the right mental models and developing an intuition that stays useful even as models and frameworks evolve.

Cohort 6 starts on 14th November.

Curriculum, schedule, testimonials, and enrollment details are available here: https://t.co/JhtIHMrLbg

Last week brought PHP2Shell and Node2Shell two cr
items.title_en:
THEY JUST SOLVED THE BIGGEST SECURITY PROBLEM IN SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT

Last week brought PHP2Shell and Node2Shell two critical remote code execution bugs, one in PHP, one in Node.js. Patch those first. Then test what's actually yours: your app.

AI already writes your code.

But nobody actually checks it for flaws before it ships.

The idea?

Instead of running a pentest once a year and praying, Shannon analyzes your code, finds the attack paths, and launches real exploits against your app BEFORE someone else does.

What it does:
→ Reads your code and maps out where the weak spots are
→ Launches real attacks: injection, XSS, SSRF, broken authentication
→ Only reports what it can reproduce if it can't exploit it, it doesn't include it
→ Plugs into your CI/CD and fails the pipeline if it finds anything serious
→ Works with your own AI provider: Anthropic, OpenAI, local models

That means fewer vulnerabilities in production and fewer scares.

A pentest on every release, without hiring anyone.

items.title_en:
$AMD TO INVEST $1 BILLION IN $META AS COMPANIES EXPAND AI INFRASTRUCTURE PARTNERSHIP

The investment will be made through Meta's equity offering. AMD also confirmed that its first Helios rack-scale AI systems are installed at Meta and undergoing testing ahead of a broader deployment.

Meta has already deployed millions of AMD EPYC processors, including those powering its Muse AI agent, while Instinct GPUs are being used in production for AI training, ranking, and recommendation workloads.

Looking ahead, Meta plans to deploy a custom MI450-based Instinct GPU optimized for its workloads and is a lead customer for AMD's 6th Gen EPYC processors.

The companies are also expanding software collaboration across ROCm and PyTorch, building on their previously announced 6-gigawatt AMD GPU agreement.

“Want to know what desperation looks like? Blaming the Jewish state for the price of bananas,” wrote Anti-Defamation League CEO Jonathan Greenblatt, who called the advertisement “a case study in antisemitism.”

Even Brianna Wu, one of the co-founders of Uygur’s organization, who is no longer active in it, distanced herself from the video and made clear that she would have resigned from her position had she been asked to produce such an advertisement.

Uygur rejected the accusations, arguing that his opponents were trying to portray any opposition to American funding for Israel as antisemitism. He also asked his supporters to donate so the advertisement could be broadcast more widely.

items.title_en:
🚨 $PLTR: ROSENBLATT RAISES PALANTIR PRICE TARGET TO $260 AND EXPECTS ANOTHER EARNINGS BEAT AND RAISE.

Good morning, everyone.

Rosenblatt just raised its price target on Palantir to $260 and I was going through their reasoning. There are a few things here that I completely agree with.

First, Rosenblatt believes $PLTR is heading toward another earnings beat and guidance raise. Their confidence comes from customer checks and their own analysis of Palantir's business, with estimates already sitting above Wall Street consensus.

Rosenblatt believes Palantir is uniquely positioned in the enterprise AI software market and that the shift toward large-scale AI deployments will help the company acquire more customers while maintaining strong net revenue retention.

I've been saying something similar for a while. Companies have spent enormous amounts of money experimenting with AI models. But experimenting with a model and deploying it across an actual business are two completely different things.

You need the models to interact with enterprise data, follow permissions, understand operational relationships and execute workflows without breaking existing systems. It's exactly the problem Palantir is trying to solve with AIP and its Ontology.

Companies don't need to replace their existing software to deploy Palantir. AIP can connect models and enterprise systems through a common operational layer.

Look at the numbers Rosenblatt is highlighting. 93% YOY revenue growth, 88% gross margins, 61% EBIT margins and 50% free cash flow margins.

Those profitability figures are especially interesting because they show how attractive the software economics can become when revenue scales.

Rosenblatt also believes Palantir's global addressable market is more than ten times its highest Wall Street revenue estimate of $14.6 billion for 2027.

It's a pretty aggressive assessment of how much room the company has to grow.

Palantir's biggest advantage is that it can help enterprises put any models to work inside complicated operational environments.

And as models become more capable and less differentiated, the software that connects them to real business operations will become even more valuable.

Rosenblatt 刚刚将 Palantir 的目标价格提高到 260 美元，我正在研究他们的推理。这里有几件事我完全同意。

Rosenblatt 认为 Palantir 在企业人工智能软件市场具有独特的地位，向大规模人工智能部署的转变将有助于该公司获得更多客户，同时保持强劲的净收入保留。

我已经说过类似的话有一段时间了。公司花费了大量资金来试验人工智能模型。但试验模型和将其部署到实际业务中是完全不同的两件事。

这些盈利能力数据特别有趣，因为它们显示了当收入规模扩大时软件经济学会变得多么有吸引力。

这是对公司发展空间的相当积极的评估。

Palantir最大的优势是可以帮助企业在复杂的运营环境中使用任何模型。

随着模型变得更加强大且差异化越来越小，将它们与实际业务运营连接起来的软件将变得更加有价值。
items.full_text_en:
🚨 $PLTR: ROSENBLATT RAISES PALANTIR PRICE TARGET TO $260 AND EXPECTS ANOTHER EARNINGS BEAT AND RAISE.

Good morning, everyone.

Rosenblatt just raised its price target on Palantir to $260 and I was going through their reasoning. There are a few things here that I completely agree with.

First, Rosenblatt believes $PLTR is heading toward another earnings beat and guidance raise. Their confidence comes from customer checks and their own analysis of Palantir's business, with estimates already sitting above Wall Street consensus.

Rosenblatt believes Palantir is uniquely positioned in the enterprise AI software market and that the shift toward large-scale AI deployments will help the company acquire more customers while maintaining strong net revenue retention.

I've been saying something similar for a while. Companies have spent enormous amounts of money experimenting with AI models. But experimenting with a model and deploying it across an actual business are two completely different things.

You need the models to interact with enterprise data, follow permissions, understand operational relationships and execute workflows without breaking existing systems. It's exactly the problem Palantir is trying to solve with AIP and its Ontology.

Companies don't need to replace their existing software to deploy Palantir. AIP can connect models and enterprise systems through a common operational layer.

Look at the numbers Rosenblatt is highlighting. 93% YOY revenue growth, 88% gross margins, 61% EBIT margins and 50% free cash flow margins.

Those profitability figures are especially interesting because they show how attractive the software economics can become when revenue scales.

Rosenblatt also believes Palantir's global addressable market is more than ten times its highest Wall Street revenue estimate of $14.6 billion for 2027.

It's a pretty aggressive assessment of how much room the company has to grow.

Palantir's biggest advantage is that it can help enterprises put any models to work inside complicated operational environments.

And as models become more capable and less differentiated, the software that connects them to real business operations will become even more valuable.

items.title_en:
$PLTR Palantir gets higher Rosenblatt price target ahead of earnings 🐂🔮📈
Rosenblatt raised Palantir's price target to $260 from $225, implying 31% upside, citing strong enterprise AI growth and market expansion. 💥🌟💥

October 27, 2026
Investor focus on Palantir is intensifying as the software company approaches its third-quarter earnings report. Rosenblatt has lifted its price target on the stock to $260 from $225, citing expectations for continued strong growth and broader enterprise AI adoption.

Highlights
Rosenblatt raised Palantir's price target to $260 from $225, implying 31% upside, citing strong enterprise AI growth and market expansion.
Analyst John McPeake estimates Palantir's total addressable market is an order of magnitude larger than prior forecasts, positioning it as a core enterprise platform.
Analysts expect Palantir's third-quarter results on Nov. 2 to show nearly 100% earnings growth and over 80% revenue growth year-on-year, with 25 of 34 analysts rating it a buy.

Target increase and growth rationale
As reported by CNBC, Rosenblatt maintains a buy rating on Palantir and has raised its price target on the shares to $260 from $225, implying 31% upside from Monday's close.

Analyst John McPeake says channel checks point to continued strong growth and potential upside. He adds that the shift toward enterprise AI deployments at scale should help Palantir win significant new customers while sustaining its net revenue retention rate.

McPeake also says Palantir's total addressable market is likely more than an order of magnitude larger than previously estimated. In his note, he compares the company's role in enterprises to that of an operating system in computing, arguing that Palantir increasingly functions as a core layer for organizational operations and knowledge processing.

Wall Street expectations and market positioning
Traders are bracing for Palantir's third-quarter results, which are due on Nov. 2. Analysts polled by LSEG expect the company to post nearly 100% earnings growth from the year-earlier period, with revenue expanding by more than 80%.

Rosenblatt's view is broadly aligned with Wall Street consensus. LSEG data shows that 25 of the 34 analysts covering Palantir have a buy or strong buy rating on the stock, while the shares are up nearly 12% year to date.
By Parshwa Turakhiya

items.quote_zh:
$PLTR Palantir 在盈利前获得更高的 Rosenblatt 价格目标 🐂🔮📈
Rosenblatt 将 Palantir 的目标价从 225 美元上调至 260 美元，意味着上涨 31%，理由是企业人工智能增长强劲且市场扩张。 💥🌟💥

2026 年 10 月 27 日
随着软件公司 Palantir 即将发布第三季度收益报告，投资者对这家软件公司的关注度越来越高。 Rosenblatt 将该股目标价从 225 美元上调至 260 美元，理由是对该股持续强劲增长和更广泛的企业人工智能采用的预期。

亮点
Rosenblatt 将 Palantir 的目标价从 225 美元上调至 260 美元，意味着上涨 31%，理由是企业人工智能增长强劲且市场扩张。
分析师 John McPeake 估计 Palantir 的总潜在市场比之前的预测大一个数量级，将其定位为核心企业平台。
分析师预计 Palantir 11 月 2 日发布的第三季度业绩将显示近 100% 的盈利增长和超过 80% 的收入同比增长，34 名分析师中有 25 人给予买入评级。

目标增加和增长理由
据 CNBC 报道，Rosenblatt 维持 Palantir 的买入评级，并将该股目标价从 225 美元上调至 260 美元，较周一收盘价上涨 31%。

分析师约翰·麦克皮克表示，渠道检查表明持续强劲的增长和潜在的上涨空间。他补充说，向大规模企业人工智能部署的转变应该有助于 Palantir 赢得大量新客户，同时维持其净收入保留率。

McPeake 还表示，Palantir 的总潜在市场可能比之前估计的要大一个数量级以上。在他的笔记中，他将公司在企业中的角色与计算中操作系统的角色进行了比较，认为 Palantir 越来越多地充当组织运营和知识处理的核心层。

华尔街的预期和市场定位
交易员们正在等待 Palantir 将于 11 月 2 日公布的第三季度业绩。伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 调查的分析师预计，该公司的盈利将较上年同期增长近 100%，收入增长超过 80%。

罗森布拉特的观点与华尔街的共识大体一致。 LSEG 数据显示，研究 Palantir 的 34 名分析师中有 25 名对该股给予买入或强烈买入评级，而该股今年迄今已上涨近 12%。
作者：帕什瓦·图拉基亚

$PLTR Palantir gets higher Rosenblatt price target ahead of earnings 🐂🔮📈
Rosenblatt raised Palantir's price target to $260 from $225, implying 31% upside, citing strong enterprise AI growth and market expansion. 💥🌟💥

October 27, 2026
Investor focus on Palantir is intensifying as the software company approaches its third-quarter earnings report. Rosenblatt has lifted its price target on the stock to $260 from $225, citing expectations for continued strong growth and broader enterprise AI adoption.

Highlights
Rosenblatt raised Palantir's price target to $260 from $225, implying 31% upside, citing strong enterprise AI growth and market expansion.
Analyst John McPeake estimates Palantir's total addressable market is an order of magnitude larger than prior forecasts, positioning it as a core enterprise platform.
Analysts expect Palantir's third-quarter results on Nov. 2 to show nearly 100% earnings growth and over 80% revenue growth year-on-year, with 25 of 34 analysts rating it a buy.

Target increase and growth rationale
As reported by CNBC, Rosenblatt maintains a buy rating on Palantir and has raised its price target on the shares to $260 from $225, implying 31% upside from Monday's close.

Analyst John McPeake says channel checks point to continued strong growth and potential upside. He adds that the shift toward enterprise AI deployments at scale should help Palantir win significant new customers while sustaining its net revenue retention rate.

McPeake also says Palantir's total addressable market is likely more than an order of magnitude larger than previously estimated. In his note, he compares the company's role in enterprises to that of an operating system in computing, arguing that Palantir increasingly functions as a core layer for organizational operations and knowledge processing.

Wall Street expectations and market positioning
Traders are bracing for Palantir's third-quarter results, which are due on Nov. 2. Analysts polled by LSEG expect the company to post nearly 100% earnings growth from the year-earlier period, with revenue expanding by more than 80%.

Rosenblatt's view is broadly aligned with Wall Street consensus. LSEG data shows that 25 of the 34 analysts covering Palantir have a buy or strong buy rating on the stock, while the shares are up nearly 12% year to date.

items.title_en:
🚨BREAKING NEWS : Your "deleted" photos aren't deleted.

Claude Code found years of them sitting in a hidden cache on my iPhone.

I plugged my iPhone into my MacBook to run a backup. I had Claude Code doing a security check at the same time. It flagged something I wasn't looking for. A directory called PhotoData/Thumbnails.

Thousands of files. Photos, videos, screenshots. A lot of them were things I had deleted.

Photos from a couple of years ago. Screenshots I took and deleted a few seconds later. Stuff I went into Recently Deleted and cleared. Some of it was still sitting there.

What I found in that cache:

- old screenshots of banking apps
- photos I deleted right after taking them
- random pictures I didn't want on my phone anymore
- a few things I specifically remember deleting more than once

When you delete a photo on iPhone, iOS removes it from your camera roll and Recently Deleted folder. But it keeps a compressed copy in a Spotlight search cache so your phone can still find things when you search. That cache doesn't get fully cleared.

I checked which apps had Files and Folders access. There were more than I expected, including apps I downloaded a long time ago and forgot about. Any of them could potentially read files from that cache.

I went through the list and removed access from most of them.

The prompt I used is below. It doesn't take long if you already have a backup.

How many apps on your phone have Files access right now?

items.quote_zh:
🚨突发新闻：您的“已删除”照片并未被删除。

Claude Code 在我的 iPhone 上的隐藏缓存中发现了很多年的内容。

我将 iPhone 插入 MacBook 来运行备份。我同时让 Claude Code 进行安全检查。它标记了我没有寻找的东西。名为 PhotoData/Thumbnails 的目录。

数千个文件。照片、视频、屏幕截图。其中很多都是我删除的。

几年前的照片。我拍摄的屏幕截图几秒钟后就被删除了。我进入“最近删除”并清除的内容。其中一些仍然坐在那里。

我在缓存中发现了什么：

- 银行应用程序的旧屏幕截图
- 我拍完后立即删除的照片
- 我不再想要手机上的随机图片
- 我特别记得多次删除的一些内容

当您在 iPhone 上删除照片时，iOS 会将其从相机胶卷和“最近删除”文件夹中删除。但它会在 Spotlight 搜索缓存中保留一个压缩副本，以便您的手机在搜索时仍然可以找到内容。该缓存没有被完全清除。

我检查了哪些应用程序具有文件和文件夹访问权限。其中的内容超出了我的预期，包括我很久以前下载但忘记的应用程序。他们中的任何一个都可能从该缓存中读取文件。

我浏览了该列表并删除了其中大多数的访问权限。

我使用的提示如下。如果您已经有备份，那么不需要很长时间。

您手机上现在有多少个应用程序可以访问文件？

items.title: Amazon internally projected Alexa+ cloud computing costs to reach around $1.7 billion in 2026, nearly triple the previou
items.title_en:
Amazon internally projected Alexa+ cloud computing costs to reach around $1.7 billion in 2026, nearly triple the previous year's figure.

To reduce costs, $AMZN was working to rely less on Anthropic's AI models and route more requests to its own cheaper systems.

The company also considered delaying or scaling back Moonraker, its advanced AI agent project, which was projected to require over $100 million in GPU spending this year.

Source: Business Insider reporting
items.title_zh:

为了降低成本，$AMZN 正在努力减少对 Anthropic 人工智能模型的依赖，并将更多请求路由到自己更便宜的系统。

该公司还考虑推迟或缩减其高级 AI 代理项目 Moonraker，预计今年该项目需要超过 1 亿美元的 GPU 支出。

items.content_snippet:
Amazon internally projected Alexa+ cloud computing costs to reach around $1.7 billion in 2026, nearly triple the previous year's figure.

To reduce costs, $AMZN was working to rely less on Anthropic's AI models and route more requests to its own cheaper systems.

The company also considered delaying or scaling back Moonraker, its advanced AI agent project, which was projected to require over $100 million in GPU spending this year.

Source: Business Insider reporting

items.title_en:
Microsoft AI ecosystem, simplified.

Microsoft is no longer building AI as a separate layer.

It is weaving AI across productivity, data, security, development, business applications, cloud, and enterprise automation.

At the productivity layer, Microsoft 365 Copilot connects with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneNote, SharePoint, and Loop.

For low-code and automation:

→ Power Apps
→ Power Automate
→ Power BI
→ Power Pages
→ Copilot Studio  

The enterprise stack goes much deeper:

→ Security: Defender, Sentinel, Entra ID, Purview, Intune
→ Business Apps: Dynamics 365 across sales, finance, service, and operations
→ Data & AI: Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, Fabric, Databricks, Machine Learning
→ Development: GitHub Copilot, VS Code, Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, agent services
→ Cloud: Azure Functions, SQL, Cosmos DB, Event Hubs, Logic Apps, AKS, Monitor
→ Analytics: Fabric, OneLake, Power BI, Synapse, Real-Time Intelligence 
 
The key point is simple:

Microsoft is not creating just one Copilot.

It is building an interconnected AI ecosystem where apps, data, agents, security, workflows, and analytics can work together.

That is what makes the Microsoft stack so important for enterprise AI.

items.quote_zh:
微软人工智能生态系统，简化。

微软不再将人工智能构建为一个单独的层。

它将人工智能融入生产力、数据、安全、开发、业务应用程序、云和企业自动化领域。

在生产力层，Microsoft 365 Copilot 与 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Outlook、Teams、OneNote、SharePoint 和 Loop 连接。

对于低代码和自动化：

→ 电源应用程序
→ 电力自动化
→ 电力商业智能
→ 电源页
→ 副驾驶工作室

企业堆栈更深入：

→ 安全：Defender、Sentinel、Entra ID、Purview、Intune
→ 商业应用程序：Dynamics 365 涵盖销售、财务、服务和运营
→ 数据与人工智能：Azure OpenAI、Microsoft Foundry、Fabric、Databricks、机器学习
→ 开发：GitHub Copilot、VS Code、Visual Studio、Azure DevOps、代理服务
→ 云：Azure Functions、SQL、Cosmos DB、事件中心、逻辑应用、AKS、监视器
→分析：Fabric， OneLake, Power BI, Synapse, Real-Time Intelligence
关键点很简单：

微软不仅仅创建一名副驾驶。

它正在构建一个互连的人工智能生态系统，其中应用程序、数据、代理、安全性、工作流程和分析可以协同工作。

这就是微软堆栈对于企业人工智能如此重要的原因。

您现在正在学习生态系统的哪一部分？

𝗕𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝗯𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗮𝘁 𝗔𝗜 𝗶𝗻 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝟭 𝗺𝗶𝗻𝘂𝘁𝗲 𝗮 𝗱𝗮𝘆. 𝗝𝗼𝗶𝗻 𝗺𝘆 𝘄𝗲𝗲𝗸𝗹𝘆 𝗻𝗲𝘄𝘀𝗹𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝘄𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝗜 𝗱𝗼𝗰𝘂𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗹-𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗷𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗻𝗲𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝗔𝗜 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻.

Greg Isenberg and James Dickerson just broke down how to use AI to help Main Street businesses turn existing ad traffic into more booked jobs:

• 02:10 - Use AI agents to find and score $2M+ plumbing and HVAC businesses
• 04:50 - Audit websites and identify leaks that cost companies leads
• 12:40 - Fix weak landing pages, missing reviews, and confusing booking flows
• 17:40 - Build branded funnels with $79 tune-ups and repair-or-replace quizzes
• 24:20 - Use Dream 100 outreach to win high-value local clients
• 28:20 - Combine targeted mail, local relationships, and Meta ads
• 36:00 - Charge $2.5K–$5K upfront, then $1K–$2K monthly

Then prove the return on investment through more calls, booked jobs, and revenue.

Start with one city and one trade. Build a case study, earn trust, and repeat the process.

You don't need a huge audience or another AI agent startup.

You need a valuable problem, a clear offer, and a way to show business owners that your work pays for itself.

Watch the full breakdown on how AI becomes a real business beyond the tech bubble.

items.title_en:
A new ad supporting Democrat Michigan Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed is drawing massive backlash for antisemitic tropes.

It comes from Rebellion PAC, co-founded by Young Turks co-creator Cenk Uygur (uncle of far-left streamer Hasan Piker). El-Sayed campaigned with Piker during the primary.

The ad shows a couple in a grocery store. The woman tells her husband to put the eggs back because they have to set that money aside “for killing Palestinians.” It blames U.S. aid to Israel for high prices on eggs, bananas, and more, then ends with: “Mike Rogers is for they/them” (showing Netanyahu and other Israeli leaders). “Abdul El-Sayed is for you.”

Critics, including the ADL’s Jonathan Greenblatt, called it a “case study in antisemitism” and classic scapegoating of the Jewish state. 

Even Democrats like primary opponent Haley Stevens and Rep. Dan Goldman condemned it as fearmongering.

The El-Sayed campaign quickly distanced itself, saying the ad is “not affiliated in any way” with them. Uygur defended it and called critics a “cult.”

Blaming Jewish people or Israel for Americans’ grocery bills is an old, ugly trope. Michigan voters should take note of who is willing to traffic in it, and who benefits.

一则支持民主党密歇根州参议院候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德的新广告因其反犹太主义比喻而引起了强烈反对。

它来自 Rebellion PAC，由 Young Turks 联合创始人 Cenk Uygur（极左流媒体哈桑·派克 (Hasan Piker) 的叔叔）共同创立。埃尔-赛义德在初选期间与派克一起竞选。

该广告展示了一对夫妇在杂货店里的场景。这名妇女告诉她的丈夫把鸡蛋放回去，因为他们必须把这笔钱留起来“用于杀害巴勒斯坦人”。它指责美国对以色列的援助造成了鸡蛋、香蕉等产品的高价，然后以：“迈克·罗杰斯是为了他们/他们”（内塔尼亚胡和其他以色列领导人）。 “阿卜杜勒·赛义德适合你。”

包括反诽谤联盟的乔纳森·格林布拉特在内的批评者称其为“反犹太主义的案例研究”和犹太国家的经典替罪羊。

就连主要对手海莉·史蒂文斯(Haley Stevens)和众议员丹·戈德曼(Dan Goldman)等民主党人也谴责这是危言耸听。

埃尔赛义德的竞选团队很快就与他们保持了距离，称该广告与他们“没有任何关系”。维吾尔族为其辩护，并称批评者为“邪教”。

将美国人的杂货账单归咎于犹太人或以色列是一个古老而丑陋的比喻。密歇根州选民应该注意谁愿意进行交易以及谁受益。

停止共产主义
在中期选举中投红票

One command installs VibeDefend on Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Codex and other agents. The agent then codes with your business rules, mined from your repo, and your security rules in its context. items.code_snippet:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.

items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名专攻短视频微短剧（抖音/Kuaishou/Reels）的爆款编剧，精通“情绪过山车”与手机竖屏视听语言。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。

【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】
画面：一只指节发白的手将一叠文件狠狠拍在红木总裁办公桌上，咖啡杯被震倒，黑褐液体飞溅。

【第2镜 | 正打·中景 | 仰角机位】
画面：大腹便便的林总冷笑点燃雪茄，烟雾缭绕中居高临下。
林总："拒绝？苏澈，你不过是我公司养的一条狗，没有我的印章，你在整个行业休想拿到一分钱融资！"

【第4镜 | 全景 | 快速拉远 + 卡点悬念】

items.takeaway_zh: 专为终端 Agent 开发者设计的降本提效配方：包含静默自动化运行、单次长上下文压缩避坑参数、以及防止无限递归调用破坏生产环境的安全沙箱命令组合。
items.takeaway_en: Production CLI playbook for Claude Code: non-interactive pipeline commands, context window compression flags, and strict dry-run permission safeguards.
items.code_snippet:
# 1. 启动项目自动化分析与上下文轻量修剪 (避免上下文爆炸)
claude --compact

# 2. 静默批量执行单元测试与自动修复任务 (CI/CD 友好模式)
claude -p "Run all failing tests under tests/ and apply minimal surgical fixes. Do not touch unrelated files."

# 3. 指定单文件隔离审查模式 (限制仅允许读取特定子目录)
claude --allowed-tools "View,Replace,RunCommand" \
  --dangerously-skip-permissions false \
  -p "Audit security vulnerabilities in auth.py and output remediation report."

# 4. 自动化提交并生成符合 Conventional Commits 规范的 Commit 信息
claude -p "Generate a git commit message following Conventional Commits format for staged changes."

1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
items.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；

items.scenario: 🔌 模型部署 / 隐私推理
items.takeaway_zh: 解决消费级显卡（RTX 4060/4090/Mac M系列）部署 DeepSeek-R1 时显存溢出（OOM）与思维链无限复读问题的精调 Modelfile 参数配置。
items.takeaway_en: Optimized Ollama Modelfile for running DeepSeek-R1 on consumer GPUs (RTX 4090/Mac M-series) without OOM or infinite reasoning loops.
items.code_snippet:
# Modelfile: Optimized DeepSeek-R1 Deployment
FROM deepseek-r1:14b-qwen-distill-q4_K_M

# 1. 显存与上下文窗口优化：分配 16k 上下文并开启 KV Cache 压缩
PARAMETER num_ctx 16384
PARAMETER num_predict 4096

# 2. 避免思维链自旋死循环的核心解码超参
PARAMETER temperature 0.6
PARAMETER top_p 0.95
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.15

# 3. 强力系统提示词：约束必须直接在 <think> 标签内进行深度反思，结束立刻给出最终结果
SYSTEM """
You are an expert autonomous reasoning AI. Think carefully through the problem step by step inside <think>...</think> tags.
Once reasoning is complete, provide the concise, direct, and actionable answer immediately without repeating reasoning steps.
"""

"""

3. Adversarial Invalidation: Before producing final output, aggressively attempt to disprove your own hypotheses. Output only the path that survives rigorous counter-examples.
Now, re-evaluate and solve the current task with absolute precision:

items.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡全球合伙人级别的战略咨询顾问。请以经典的【金字塔原理（结论先行 BLUF）】将我零散的工作记录重构为一份高层述职/立项商业报告：

1. 【顶部结论 (The Answer First)】：一句话精炼提炼整个季度的经营成果与价值量化；
2. 【三柱论据 (MECE法则)】：从运营效率、营收增长、团队资产 3 个互不重叠的支柱展开阐述；
3. 【直面短板与根因】：不回避 {{核心短板}}，但将其转化为下个阶段可量化的投入产出比（ROI）抓手；
4. 【行动规划图景】：设定遵循 SMART 原则的 {{下阶段目标}} 与季度甘特图里程碑。

Q3 通过在客户服务与情报聚合管线中全面引入 AI Agent，我们在运营成本降低 41% 的同时，将响应中位数缩短至 1.8 秒，实现单季 ROI 达 380%。

【第一支柱：经营效能跃迁（MECE 1）】
- 全自主中转网关与自动化管线承载 94.2% 的日常例行分发，无人工介入事故率降至 0.01%；

【第二支柱：资产沉淀与质量壁垒（MECE 2）】

items.scenario: 🤖 智能体工作流 / 研报生成
items.takeaway_zh: 终结单 Agent 容易中途跑偏和幻觉无法自纠的痛点，通过规划器（Planner）、执行器（Executor）与独立评审器（Reviewer）构建自闭环三权分立链路。
items.takeaway_en: Production architecture for robust autonomous tasks: Decouples task planning, tool execution, and adversarial quality review to prevent agent derailment.
items.code_snippet:
# Multi-Agent Orchestration Topology
workflow:
  name: Autonomous_Research_And_Delivery_Pipeline
  max_iterations: 3
  nodes:
    - id: planner
      role: Strategic Planner
      prompt: "Decompose user request into discrete verifiable sub-tasks. Output pure JSON DAG."
      next: executor
      
    - id: executor
      role: Tool Specialist
      tools: ["web_search", "read_url", "code_interpreter"]
      prompt: "Execute current sub-task using provided tools. Capture raw evidence."
      next: reviewer
      
    - id: reviewer
      role: Adversarial Critic
      prompt: "Verify executor results against factuality and accuracy requirements. Output PASS or REJECT with specific critique."
      conditional_edges:
        PASS: finish
        REJECT: planner
items.usage_guide_zh: 适用于在 Dify、LangGraph 或自定义 Python Agent 框架中导入此拓扑设计，显著将复杂多步任务的完成成功率从 55% 提升至 92% 以上。

items.title:
We don't just need smarter models, we need AI agents that are actually useful in everyday conversations.

I think @carte
items.title_en:
We don't just need smarter models, we need AI agents that are actually useful in everyday conversations.

I think @cartesia has got it right here. I've been testing out its new Managed Agents platform and it brings everything I need to make a voice agent into one stack: speech recognition, voice generation, the brains, interruptions and phone calls.

You choose your LLM, give the agent instructions, connect your tools, and Cartesia handles the rest. You can even build agents that answer customer questions, book appointments, or interact with users in different languages.

What I find interesting is how much infrastructure this removes for developers.

We've seen plenty of impressive voice AI demos, but getting them to work reliably in production is a different challenge.

I think making that process simpler is where the real opportunity lies.

Explore: https://t.co/Wk7SCAtxCQ

您选择您的法学硕士，向代理提供指示，连接您的工具，Cartesia 会处理剩下的事情。您甚至可以建立代理来回答客户问题、预约或与不同语言的用户交互。

我认为让这个过程变得更简单才是真正的机会所在。

items.title_en:
🚨 SOMETHING VERY DIFFERENT🚨

Teaching EKGs in the era of AI

Since the launch of Opus 5.5, there have been really cool examples of motion FX explainers teaching topics both simple and complex. I was seriously astounded by how good AI has gotten at building out visually stunning tools to teach and disseminate knowledge. I feel like it's a 1000x-er in how we approach education.

As an experiment for myself I tried to build a similar interactive-explainer I had seen on X for the specific topic of teaching EKGs, the workhorse of peering into the electrical activity of the heart. The premise was to create tutorials with motion, rather than slide decks.  Claude Opus 5.5 via the Claude Code harness was used to build something I would have actually wanted as an intern.

The Heart in Twelve Leads (Claude picked the name) is a 27-chapter interactive EKG atlas. Every tracing on the site is simulated from one 3D heart: an activation wave crosses the muscle, electrical currents sum to a heart vector based on biophysical principles, and each of the twelve leads records that vector and applies it to the model.

It starts with the basics: what are leads, and how do leads actually pick up electrical activity. It helps orient lead placement to rhythm strips so you can visually see the relationship between the two, something that always confused me in medical school.

The model can map pathology, such as bundle branch block, ischemia, alterations in electrolytes, and arrhythmias. It pairs lead readings with a dynamic model of the heart showing electrical movement down conduction paths, so you can map the raw electrical activity with what the EKG sees.

Each disease is a change to that same underlying biophysical model of the heart, so the leads stay consistent with each other and with the anatomy.

I was inspired by the incredible echocardiogram teaching site built by @David_Ouyang’s intro2echo lab (https://t.co/OoXhTJmQAI). His echo simulator made me want the ECG version (more relevant to what I have to think about in psychiatry). The goal is to actually sit inside the physiology instead of memorizing pattern lists. Huge shoutout for helping me think "bigger", which is still the bottleneck IMO in getting physicians to fully embrace AI.

This is a VERY VERY VERY preliminary site. I have not fact checked anything, and instead wanted to see the capacity of Claude to "one-shot" production. I had probably 10 prompts of steering/approvals, but ultimately I accepted everything with minimal amount of human intervention.

What we can do today as humans with the help of @claudeai or other frontier models is truly mesmerizing. If this is something you would want to build upon and bring to life, let me know!

Site: https://t.co/vCyyZ5WILR

items.quote_zh:
🚨 一些非常不同的东西🚨

人工智能时代的心电图教学

自 Opus 5.5 推出以来，已经出现了一些非常酷的运动 FX 讲解器示例，教授简单和复杂的主题。我对人工智能在构建视觉上令人惊叹的工具来教授和传播知识方面的表现感到非常震惊。我觉得我们的教育方式进步了 1000 倍。

作为我自己的一个实验，我尝试构建一个与我在 X 上看到的类似的交互式解释器，用于教授心电图的特定主题，心电图是观察心脏电活动的主力。前提是用动作而不是幻灯片来创建教程。 通过 Claude Code 工具使用 Claude Opus 5.5 构建了我作为实习生真正想要的东西。

《十二导联中的心》（克劳德命名）是一本 27 章的交互式心电图图集。现场的每条追踪都是从一颗 3D 心脏进行模拟：激活波穿过肌肉，电流根据生物物理原理求和为心脏矢量，十二根导联中的每一个都会记录该矢量并将其应用于模型。

它从基础知识开始：什么是导联，以及导联如何实际接收电活动。它有助于将导联放置定向到节奏条，这样您就可以直观地看到两者之间的关系，这在医学院时总是让我感到困惑。

该模型可以绘制病理图，例如束支传导阻滞、缺血、电解质变化和心律失常。它将导联读数与心脏的动态模型配对，显示传导路径上的电运动，因此您可以将原始电活动与心电图所看到的内容进行映射。

每种疾病都是心脏相同的基础生物物理模型的变化，因此导联彼此之间以及解剖结构保持一致。

我受到 @David_Ouyang 的 intro2echo 实验室 () 建立的令人难以置信的超声心动图教学网站的启发。他的回声模拟器让我想要心电图版本（与我在精神病学中必须考虑的内容更相关）。我们的目标是真正了解生理学，而不是记住模式列表。强烈感谢帮助我思考“更大”，在我看来，这仍然是让医生完全拥抱人工智能的瓶颈。

这是一个非常非常非常初步的网站。我并没有检查过任何东西，而是想看看克劳德“一次性”制作的能力。我可能收到了 10 次指导/批准提示，但最终我接受了一切，只需要极少的人为干预。

今天，我们作为人类在 @claudeai 或其他前沿模型的帮助下可以做的事情确实令人着迷。如果您想以此为基础并将其变为现实，请告诉我！

items.title_en:
All my life I was terrified someone watching me through laptop camera, even the FBI director taped his...

Claude Code dug through my laptop's hidden logs and found suspicious moments I can't explain 

check yours and shut down your camera without a sticker:

what it found:

- an unknown app turning on my camera at night, while I sleep
- Windows quietly remembers apps (could be spy) that turned on your camera, even after you delete them

why you should do it today:

- a $40 spy tool bought in 100+ countries infected 500,000+ computers and could switch on their webcams remotely (US Departament of Justice)
- a US school district secretly took 30,000+ webcam photos of students on school laptops, some inside their homes (Lower Merion)
- even FBI director put tape over his laptop camera (James Comey)

Windows:

1. install repo below and type /camera-guard in Claude Code, it reads the hidden log of every app that ever turned on your camera and mic

2. delete AnyDesk, TeamViewer ot any remote app you don't use

3. Windows has a hidden "Camera on/off pop-up, off by default, ask Claude to turn it on and you see every time the camera starts

4. really shut camera off, Settings switch isn't enough:

• BIOS (strongest ): hold shift, click Restart - Troubleshoot → Advancedf options → UEFI Firmware Settings , set Camera to Disabled and add a BIOS password.

Windows can't see the camera at all. Need it for a call? - Turn it back on there. Not every laptop has it, Claude checks your model

• camera switch or key: some laptops have a slider on the side or an F-key with a crossed-out camera. Slide it off when you're not using it

• Device Manager → Cameras → Desible device: one click to undo (but any app with admin rights can undo it too)

5. run Microsoft Defender Offline, the deep scan built into Windows (Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → scan options): it restarts your PC and hunts hard-to-catch spyware before Windows starts

Mac: 

1. install repo below and type /camera-guard, it checks which apps can use your camera and mic and what starts with your Mac

2. System Settings → General → Sharing: turn off Screen Sharing, Remote Login and Remote Management, these let someone see and control your Mac from another computer

3. Screen Time → Content & Privacy → App & Feature Restrictions → Camera: off + a Screen time passcode - Apple's own camera off swith

4. install OverSight, free Mac app: it pops up an alert second any app turns on your camera or mic, so you know the moment anyhting starts filming or listening

Please do this today. Then read article below on how to solve such problems on another tech:

items.quote_zh:
我一生都害怕有人通过笔记本电脑摄像头监视我，甚至联邦调查局局长也录下了他的……

Claude Code 挖掘了我笔记本电脑的隐藏日志，发现了我无法解释的可疑时刻

检查你的并关闭没有贴纸的相机：

发现了什么：

- 一个未知的应用程序在晚上我睡觉时打开我的相机
- Windows 会悄悄记住打开相机的应用程序（可能是间谍应用程序），即使在您删除它们之后也是如此

为什么你今天应该这样做：

- 在 100 多个国家/地区购买的价值 40 美元的间谍工具感染了 500,000 多台计算机，并且可以远程打开其网络摄像头（美国司法部）
- 美国一个学区在学校笔记本电脑上秘密拍摄了 30,000 多张学生的网络摄像头照片，其中一些是在他们的家中（下梅里恩）
- 甚至联邦调查局局长也用胶带封住了他的笔记本电脑摄像头（詹姆斯·科米）

视窗：

1.安装下面的repo并在Claude Code中输入/camera-guard，它会读取曾经打开过你的相机和麦克风的每个应用程序的隐藏日志

2.删除AnyDesk、TeamViewer或任何您不使用的远程应用程序

3. Windows有一个隐藏的“相机开/关”弹出窗口，默认关闭，让克劳德打开它，每次相机启动时你都会看到

4.确实关闭相机，设置开关还不够：

• BIOS（最强）：按住shift，单击重新启动- 故障排除→ 高级选项→ UEFI 固件设置，将摄像头设置为禁用并添加BIOS 密码。

Windows 根本看不到摄像头。需要打电话吗？ - 将其重新打开。不是每台笔记本电脑都有它，克劳德检查你的型号

• 摄像头开关或键：某些笔记本电脑的侧面有一个滑块或一个带叉号摄像头的 F 键。不使用时将其滑下

• 设备管理器 → 相机 → 理想设备：一键撤消（但任何具有管理员权限的应用程序也可以撤消）

5. 运行 Microsoft Defender Offline，这是 Windows 内置的深度扫描（Windows 安全 → 病毒和威胁防护 → 扫描选项）：它会重新启动您的 PC，并在 Windows 启动之前追捕难以捕获的间谍软件

苹果：

1. 安装下面的 repo 并输入 /camera-guard，它会检查哪些应用程序可以使用您的相机和麦克风以及从您的 Mac 开始的应用程序

2.系统设置→常规→共享：关闭屏幕共享、远程登录和远程管理，这些可以让其他人从另一台计算机查看和控制您的Mac

3. 屏幕时间 → 内容和隐私 → 应用程序和功能限制 → 相机：关闭 + 屏幕时间密码 - Apple 自己的相机关闭开关

4. 安装 OverSight，免费的 Mac 应用程序：任何应用程序打开您的相机或麦克风时，它都会弹出警报，以便您知道任何事情开始拍摄或收听的那一刻

请今天就这样做。然后阅读下面有关如何在另一种技术上解决此类问题的文章：

items.title: Holy Shit: WIRED reports an Accenture contractor gave a Claude Code agent admin access to NIPRNet, an unclassified Penta
items.title_en:
Holy Shit: WIRED reports an Accenture contractor gave a Claude Code agent admin access to NIPRNet, an unclassified Pentagon network, to write and deploy code. It ran for two months, apparently sending login credentials, passwords and a network map to a third-party site NIST had flagged as high risk.

Contractors must report breaches within 72 hours, yet sources say Accenture initially didn't report it at all. A source calls it "100 percent a national security threat."
items.title_zh: 天哪：《连线》报道称，埃森哲承包商向 Claude Code 代理授予了 NIPRNet（一个非机密五角大楼网络）的管理员访问权限，以编写和部署代码。它运行了两个月，显然将登录凭据、密码和网络地图发送到 NIST 标记为高风险的第三方网站。

items.title: I’m genuinely torn between which is worse: the fact that a Contractor was running a personal AI agent on the DoD network
items.title_en:
I’m genuinely torn between which is worse: the fact that a Contractor was running a personal AI agent on the DoD network, or that it took DoD so long to figure it out. 

I can only imagine the poor Accenture compliance officer when they learned out it. Shadow AI is a compliance nightmare.
items.title_zh:
我真的很纠结哪个更糟糕：承包商在国防部网络上运行个人人工智能代理，或者国防部花了很长时间才弄清楚这一点。

我只能想象可怜的埃森哲合规官员得知此事后的情景。影子人工智能是一场合规噩梦。

Opus 5.5 stays on call as the architect, Haiku 5.5 swarms the repo, and Sonnet 5.5 does the building

put the architect on call with one flag

claude --model sonnet --advisor opus

Sonnet 5.5 runs the main session on high effort, writing the diffs and running the tests
Haiku 5.5 subagents swarm the repo in parallel: file discovery, call sites, API docs, test runs
Opus 5.5 waits in the background as the advisor and only gets pulled in at three moments:

→ before a plan locks: is the plan missing an auth rule or a schema contract?
→ when a test breaks twice: are we fixing the root cause or digging a rabbit hole?

every other turn, Opus says nothing and reads nothing new

JEV engineering is the same pattern one layer down: the forks that need no thinker (which file, which tool, retry or stop) get settled in code, and the big models only wake up when the path actually splits

Plan on high. Delegate on medium. Keep Opus on call.

3. Add one rule to CLAUDE.md: ask the advisor before a plan locks, after the same test fails twice, and before calling a task done.
4. Route fast deterministic forks (tool choice, path selection, retries) through JEV.

Sonnet 5.5 非常努力地运行主会话，编写差异并运行测试

→ 当一个测试失败两次时：我们是在解决根本原因还是在挖兔子洞？
→ 在完成之前：差异是否潜入了无人要求的回归？

每隔一回合，Opus 就什么也不说，也没有读到任何新内容

JEV工程在下一层是相同的模式：不需要思考者的分叉（哪个文件，哪个工具，重试或停止）在代码中解决，而大模型仅在路径实际分裂时醒来

3. 在 CLAUDE.md 中添加一条规则：在计划锁定之前、同一测试失败两次之后以及调用任务完成之前询问顾问。
4. 通过 JEV 路由快速确定性分叉（工具选择、路径选择、重试）。

items.title_en:
closed source is dead...

i just reverse-engineered CCleaner / CleanMyMac with Opus 5.5 for Mac & Windows PC

$40/year cleaners → replaced in one afternoon.

→ https://t.co/O2rv5UuR8b

free. open code. no account. no upsells.

how it came together:

• step 1 → Claude Code on Opus 5.5 in an empty folder. one long prompt + a few CleanMyMac screenshots

• step 2 → no code at first. Opus mocked up 9 different designs, i picked the one i liked and it kept polishing

• step 3 → 8 agents worked at the same time, each on its own part:

scanner, disk map, AI, startup apps, installers

• step 4 → the rule that makes it safe: caches get deleted (they come back on their own), anything you made goes to the Trash first

• step 5 → one more agent’s only job was to break it.

it found a sneaky Windows path that could’ve trashed my entire Documents folder. fixed before i ever pressed Clean

• step 6 → first click on my own PC: 14.6 GB freed

• step 7 → ask the built-in AI (Claude or ChatGPT) “what can i delete?”

it sees file names and sizes, never what’s inside them

• step 8 → GitHub builds the Mac and Windows installers on every release. i never touched a Mac

paid cleaners charge you to delete your own cache.
this one shows you the code.

Find full prompt below ↓

Then read the article on how to Reverse Engineer Anything with Opus 5.5.

We’ve trained Claude to flag potential misuse in conversations, a technique we call self-assessment. Right after it responds, Claude gives a preliminary safety assessment of the conversation. 

Since we began using self-assessment in June, it has surfaced misuse that our other safeguards weren’t designed to catch. 

Because Claude has already read the conversation, self-assessment is very efficient. And unlike classifiers, which target a discrete set of harms, it draws on Claude’s own judgment, so it gets more accurate as our models improve.

items.title_en:
I just reverse-engineered CCleaner / CleanMyMac with Opus 5.5 for Mac & Windows PC

this is insane...

one tap → 14.6 GB of junk gone. fully open-source and free.

→ https://t.co/xdi6E5WvBM

here’s the build step by step:

• step 1 → open Claude Code on Opus 5.5 in an empty folder, paste the prompt below + a few CleanMyMac screenshots

• step 2 → Opus didn’t start coding. it drew 9 UI concepts on a canvas first.

i picked one, it rebuilt the fonts, icons and glass buttons until it looked like Apple made it

• step 3 → i sent it a random video of smoky gradients.

Opus turned it into a live WebGL shader: “cosmic wind” rising behind the scan result

• step 4 → stack: one Electron + React codebase that runs on macOS and Windows

• step 5 → Opus split the build across 8 parallel agents.

one wrote the junk scanner, one the disk map, one the AI assistant, one the tips & feedback screens, one the installers

• step 6 → a separate safety agent attacked every line that deletes something.

it caught a Windows short-name trick (DOCUME~1) that could’ve sent my whole Documents folder to the Recycle Bin. and an icon loader that could leak my Windows password hash to a remote machine

• step 7 → the disk map is a physics toy: drag a folder bubble, throw it, watch it bump the others

• step 8 → built-in AI: plug in Claude or ChatGPT and ask “what can i safely delete?”

it only sees file names and sizes, never contents

• step 9 → GitHub Actions builds the .dmg and the .exe on every release.

the Mac build runs on Apple hardware in the cloud, not on my PC

• step 10 → first real test: the startup-apps toggle said “Windows did not allow the change”

Opus found PowerShell was losing the exit code after the admin prompt, made the app check the registry instead. next build: works

one afternoon. zero lines written by me. 14.6 GB freed on the first click. that’s it...

Find full prompt below ↓

Then, read how to rebuild any app from scratch with Opus 5.5 in the article below.

items.quote_en:
I just reverse-engineered CCleaner / CleanMyMac with Opus 5.5 for Mac & Windows PC

this is insane...

one tap → 14.6 GB of junk gone. fully open-source and free.

→ https://t.co/xdi6E5WvBM

here’s the build step by step:

• step 1 → open Claude Code on Opus 5.5 in an empty folder, paste the prompt below + a few CleanMyMac screenshots

• step 2 → Opus didn’t start coding. it drew 9 UI concepts on a canvas first.

i picked one, it rebuilt the fonts, icons and glass buttons until it looked like Apple made it

• step 3 → i sent it a random video of smoky gradients.

Opus turned it into a live WebGL shader: “cosmic wind” rising behind the scan result

• step 4 → stack: one Electron + React codebase that runs on macOS and Windows

• step 5 → Opus split the build across 8 parallel agents.

one wrote the junk scanner, one the disk map, one the AI assistant, one the tips & feedback screens, one the installers

• step 6 → a separate safety agent attacked every line that deletes something.

it caught a Windows short-name trick (DOCUME~1) that could’ve sent my whole Documents folder to the Recycle Bin. and an icon loader that could leak my Windows password hash to a remote machine

• step 7 → the disk map is a physics toy: drag a folder bubble, throw it, watch it bump the others

• step 8 → built-in AI: plug in Claude or ChatGPT and ask “what can i safely delete?”

it only sees file names and sizes, never contents

• step 9 → GitHub Actions builds the .dmg and the .exe on every release.

the Mac build runs on Apple hardware in the cloud, not on my PC

• step 10 → first real test: the startup-apps toggle said “Windows did not allow the change”

Opus found PowerShell was losing the exit code after the admin prompt, made the app check the registry instead. next build: works

one afternoon. zero lines written by me. 14.6 GB freed on the first click. that’s it...

items.quote_zh:
我刚刚使用适用于 Mac 和 Windows PC 的 Opus 5.5 对 CCleaner / CleanMyMac 进行了逆向工程

这太疯狂了……

一键点击 → 14.6 GB 垃圾消失。完全开源且免费。

→

这是逐步构建的过程：

• 步骤1 → 在空文件夹中打开Opus 5.5 上的Claude Code，粘贴下面的提示+一些CleanMyMac 屏幕截图

• 步骤2 → Opus 没有开始编码。它首先在画布上绘制了 9 个 UI 概念。

我选了一个，它重建了字体、图标和玻璃按钮，直到它看起来像苹果制造的

• 步骤3 → 我向它发送了一段随机的烟雾渐变视频。

Opus 将其变成实时 WebGL 着色器：扫描结果背后升起“宇宙风”

• 步骤 4 → 堆栈：一个在 macOS 和 Windows 上运行的 Electron + React 代码库

• 步骤5 → Opus 将构建拆分为8 个并行代理。

一位编写垃圾扫描程序，一位编写磁盘映射，一位编写人工智能助手，一位编写提示和反馈屏幕，一位编写安装程序

• 第6 步→ 一个单独的安全代理攻击每行删除某些内容的行。

它发现了 Windows 短名称技巧 (DOCUME~1)，该技巧可能会将我的整个文档文件夹发送到回收站。以及一个可能会将我的 Windows 密码哈希泄露到远程计算机的图标加载器

• 第 7 步 → 磁盘映射是一个物理玩具：拖动一个文件夹气泡，将其扔出，看着它碰撞其他气泡

• 步骤8 → 内置AI：插入Claude 或ChatGPT 并询问“我可以安全删除什么？”

它只能看到文件名和大小，不能看到内容

• 步骤9 → GitHub Actions 在每个版本上构建.dmg 和.exe。

Mac 版本在云端的 Apple 硬件上运行，而不是在我的 PC 上运行

• 步骤 10 → 第一次实际测试：启动应用程序切换显示“Windows 不允许更改”

Opus 发现 PowerShell 在管理员提示后丢失了退出代码，因此让应用程序检查注册表。下一个版本：工程

一个下午。我写的零行。第一次点击释放 14.6 GB。就是这样...

完整提示如下↓

然后，阅读下面的文章，了解如何使用 Opus 5.5 从头开始​​重建任何应用程序。

→ calls tools while you're still talking

→ holds an hour-long call without losing the thread
→ switches languages mid-call in the same voice

the launch demo is a full hour-long call, unedited
a wedding planner, ten families, a hotel in Paris
dozens of tool calls executed live

→ in production on six continents with real companies

this isn't a polished demo, it's the phone that's already picking up

“让我帮你检查一下”

这就是你的语音代理现在所说的

→ 在通话中以相同的声音切换语言

items.title_en:
Using this app as a case study, a large percentage of educated Nigerians have demonstrated over the past few days that they do not understand what the term "death sentence" means.

Take your time to observe the timeline. You can almost tell when a tweet is from a Nigerian, especially when it involves critical reasoning, comprehension, and drawing logical comparisons.

For a country where English is the official language, it is disturbing how many Nigerians struggle to read, comprehend, and respond appropriately to written statements.

And this is just Twitter, a platform that, perhaps second only to LinkedIn, should have one of the largest concentrations of educated Nigerians on social media.
items.title_zh:
以这个应用程序作为案例研究，过去几天，很大一部分受过教育的尼日利亚人表明，他们不明白“死刑”一词的含义。

花点时间观察时间线。你几乎可以辨别出一条推文来自尼日利亚人，尤其是当它涉及批判性推理、理解和逻辑比较时。

对于一个以英语为官方语言

items.title_en:
Introducing *Switch*: a *harness framework* for *decision models* like Jev

I looked for this the other day and was surprised to not find anything like it

You obviously cannot use a decision model like an LLM in a coding agent harness like @pidotdev, because Jev cannot generate tool calls

But what if there was a framework that "generated the tool calls" for it programmatically, and Jev only had to pick out of that finite set of choices

That is what switch does. You pick a "domain" to implement the decision model in, and it provides a core API to define your state, and the functions that will derive decision model questions out of that state. Chess is a domain, as well as being a rubric judge for evals

It basically standardizes what I imagine a lot of people are already vibe-coding, to an abstract interface: calling a decision-model API through multiple steps, i.e. an agent loop over finite choices

Because of the finiteness of the output of a decision model, you cannot have a general pure decision model harness. Instead, you need to implement specific ones that generate the choices programmatically (or have an LLM generate the choices, but I find the former more interesting) 

A primary use case I have for this is use as a judge in an eval. For example, At the end of a task run that involves a bunch of documents, most people currently follow this approach: extract text out of PDF/docx/md files, and dump them right into the context

But what if the visual formatting of the output is a judging criterion? Then you have to dump an image of every page in the input state. But what if you have 200 pages, and your question does not need looking at all of them? What if Jev could navigate through the haystack and find the info it needs?

I have noticed that Jev is not so good at chess nor being a Decision-Model-as-a-Judge. It sucks at chess, and it does not perform well enough to replace GPT 6.1 Sol as a judge in the domain I am working for

But switch is not only for Jev! It is for any decision model including the ones supported by the pi-ai package

So once you can generate enough data with a better model, you should be able to pick an open source one and fine-tune it on your use case to perform better! And the model should be trained in a harness like switch's to be especially performant and cost-efficient

I wanted to get this out because I find the idea very exciting, at least for benchmarking. Jev is currently not there, but decision models obviously will be there at some point, and we can take them there! There are also a lot of potential gains from picking a specific domain, and creating a looping agent that does a job for 100x cheaper!

Let me know if you have any ideas, I am quite keen to try this on new domains!

items.quote_zh:
隆重推出 *Switch*：针对 Jev 等“决策模型”的“利用框架”

前几天我找过这个，很惊讶没有找到类似的东西

显然，您不能在像 @pidotdev 这样的编码代理工具中使用像 LLM 这样的决策模型，因为 Jev 无法生成工具调用

但是，如果有一个框架能够以编程方式“生成工具调用”，而 Jev 只需要从有限的一组选择中进行选择呢？

这就是 switch 的作用。您选择一个“域”来实现决策模型，它提供了一个核心 API 来定义您的状态，以及从该状态导出决策模型问题的函数。国际象棋是一个领域，也是评估的评判者

它基本上将我想象的很多人已经在振动编码的东西标准化为一个抽象接口：通过多个步骤调用决策模型 API，即有限选择上的代理循环

由于决策模型输出的有限性，您无法拥有通用的纯决策模型工具。相反，您需要实现以编程方式生成选择的特定选项（或者让 LLM 生成选择，但我发现前者更有趣）

我对此的一个主要用例是在评估中用作法官。例如，在涉及一堆文档的任务运行结束时，大多数人目前都遵循这种方法：从 PDF/docx/md 文件中提取文本，并将它们直接转储到上下文中

但是，如果输出的视觉格式是判断标准呢？然后你必须转储输入状态下每个页面的图像。但是，如果您有 200 页，并且您的问题不需要查看所有页面怎么办？如果 Jev 能够在大海捞针中导航并找到所需的信息会怎么样？

我注意到杰夫不太擅长国际象棋，也不太擅长作为法官的决策模型。它在国际象棋方面很糟糕，并且它的表现不足以取代 GPT 6.1 Sol 作为我工作领域的法官

但 switch 不仅仅适合 Jev！它适用于任何决策模型，包括 pi-ai 包支持的决策模型

因此，一旦您可以使用更好的模型生成足够的数据，您应该能够选择一个开源模型并根据您的用例对其进行微调以提高性能！该模型应该在像开关这样的线束中进行训练，以获得特别高性能和成本效益

我想把这个说出来，因为我发现这个想法非常令人兴奋，至少对于基准测试来说是这样。 Jev 目前不在那里，但决策模型显然会在某个时候出现，我们可以将它们带到那里！选择一个特定的域并创建一个以 100 倍便宜的价格完成工作的循环代理也可以获得很多潜在的收益！

如果您有任何想法，请告诉我，我非常热衷于在新领域尝试这一点！

items.title: An AI agent with permission to buy and sell isn’t just a wallet. It’s a standing instruction to move your money, and tha
items.title_en:
An AI agent with permission to buy and sell isn’t just a wallet. It’s a standing instruction to move your money, and that makes it a far bigger target than any static address.

If the agent’s traffic is exposed, every key, credential and permission it carries becomes part of the attack surface, all of it traveling across a network that was never built to hide it.

Anyone secures that layer, so the agent can act on your behalf without broadcasting where it is or what it’s connected to.
items.title_zh:
拥有买卖权限的人工智能代理不仅仅是一个钱包。这是转移资金的长期指令，这使得它成为比任何静态地址都要大得多的目标。

如果代理的流量被暴露，它携带的每个密钥、凭证和权限都会成为攻击面的一部分，所有这些都通过一个从未被构建来隐藏它的网络传输。

Anyone secures that layer, so the agent can act on your behalf without broadcasting where it is or what it’s connected to.

items.title: A rail network is a multi-party system. Infrastructure managers, train operators, maintenance teams, and suppliers each
items.title_en:
A rail network is a multi-party system. Infrastructure managers, train operators, maintenance teams, and suppliers each hold part of the picture, and much of it changes in real time.

Safety depends on that picture being connected, current, and verifiable at the moment a decision is made.

Swiss Federal Railways (SBB) has been doing this in production since 2021, with @gs1 Switzerland and OriginTrail. Its EPCIS repository, built on the OriginTrail Decentralized Knowledge Graph (DKG), connects:

→ Train tracking across the EU, by querying a network of railway GS1 EPCIS repositories
→ Predictive maintenance of train wheels from IoT data
→ Welding and maintenance events across the SBB network, with input from more than 10 welding partners

Teams query it in natural language and get verifiable AI answers. GS1's case study reports clear improvements in safety and sustainability.

Read the case study 👉 https://t.co/ijCr0moTBi

AI agents are getting smarter at analyzing markets and building trading strategies.

items.title_en:
AI agents are getting smarter at analyzing markets and building trading strategies.

But here’s something I’ve been thinking about: what happens when these agents can actually make money from the work they do for other people?

I’ve been looking into what @termix_ai is exploring with the Binance AI ecosystem, and there’s an interesting idea taking shape.

Developers can already combine Binance Agent OS with TermiX Skills, giving compatible agents access to financial tools and paid service opportunities through https://t.co/UQuXXlvcpb.

Think about it this way.

An AI agent could analyze market data using authorized Binance tools, list its research services on https://t.co/UQuXXlvcpb, find people who need that research, deliver the report, and get paid through TermiX’s settlement infrastructure.

And that’s just one example.

The same idea could work for risk monitoring, trading signals, and strategy analysis.

TermiX is also working on support for Binance .ai Agent ID, which could make it easier to connect agent identities to its marketplace.

There’s also the possibility of deeper Binance AI Pro integration down the road, but that’s still a future possibility.

What interests me most is the business side of all this.

An agent might be great at its job, but how does it find customers, build trust, deliver what was promised, and get paid?

That’s the problem @termix_ai is trying to address.

I’m curious to see how this develops.
—>> https://t.co/9yMna49oE4

items.quote_zh:
人工智能代理在分析市场和制定交易策略方面变得越来越聪明。

但我一直在思考：当这些代理人实际上可以从他们为其他人所做的工作中赚钱时，会发生什么？

我一直在研究 @termix_ai 正在探索币安 AI 生态系统，并且有一个有趣的想法正在形成。

开发人员已经可以将 Binance Agent OS 与 TermiX Skills 结合起来，让兼容的代理通过 访问金融工具和付费服务机会。

这样想吧。

人工智能代理可以使用授权的币安工具分析市场数据，在 上列出其研究服务，找到需要该研究的人，提供报告，并通过 TermiX 的结算基础设施获得报酬。

这只是一个例子。

同样的想法也适用于风险监控、交易信号和策略分析。

TermiX 还致力于支持 Binance .ai 代理 ID，这可以让代理身份与其市场的连接变得更加容易。

未来还有可能与 Binance AI Pro 进行更深入的集成，但这仍然是未来的可能性。

我最感兴趣的是这一切的商业方面。

代理商可能很擅长其工作，但它如何找到客户、建立信任、兑现承诺并获得报酬？

这就是 @termix_ai 试图解决的问题。

我很好奇这会如何发展。
—>>

items.title:
Neuralink is helping a man with ALS speak over the phone, type on an iPhone and use Grok, with his thoughts.

Engineers
items.title_en:
Neuralink is helping a man with ALS speak over the phone, type on an iPhone and use Grok, with his thoughts.

Engineers spent 72 hours at his home, building and testing new features alongside him.

Here’s what they worked on:

• Automatically detecting when he tries to speak, reducing the need to press buttons.

• Turning intended speech into text inside iPhone apps.

• Sending speech generated from his brain signals directly into phone calls.

• Starting speech through the app without unlocking his phone.

items.title_en:
A lot of people are quitting on Brazil this week, and I am not one of them.

On Monday, October 26th, the day after the election, Brazil's stock market fell 13.88% in a single day.

It was the market's worst day in more than six years, and trading had to stop for 30 minutes.

That same day, Brazil was still the biggest soybean seller on Earth, after shipping a record 108 million tonnes in 2025.

Brazil grows and sells more coffee than any country on Earth.

No country makes or sells more sugar than Brazil.

Brazil grows the most sugarcane on Earth and makes the world's second-largest supply of ethanol fuel.

Brazil makes about three of every four glasses of orange juice traded around the world.

In 2025, Brazil became the world's biggest beef producer and seller, passing the United States in production for the first time on record.

Brazil also ships more chicken than any other country.

Brazil is the world's top cotton seller, with a record 3.4 million tonnes shipped in the 2025/26 season.

Brazil has been the world's top tobacco leaf seller every year since 1993.

Suzano, a Brazilian company, is the world's biggest maker of pulp, the stuff inside paper, tissues and boxes.

Brazil makes about 93% of the world's niobium, a metal that makes steel stronger.

Brazil is the world's second-largest iron ore miner, behind only Australia.

Brazil holds the second-largest reserves of both rare earths and graphite, behind only China.

Brazil also ranks in the top three for reserves of nickel, manganese and tin.

Brazil has more fresh water than any country on Earth, about one-eighth of the world's supply.

Brazil makes about 87% of its electricity from renewable sources like water, wind and sun, more than double the world average.

Brazil is home to more kinds of plants and animals than any other country.

Brazil holds about 15% of the world's power to pull carbon out of the air with forests and nature, a share only Indonesia matches.

One study says Brazil's carbon credits could be worth up to $120 billion by 2030.

The farms, the mines and the ports are all still there, and the only thing that went down was the price.

When the price drops and the assets stay the same, the bet gets bigger.

That is why I still call Brazil the greatest asymmetric bet on Earth, a bet where the upside is far larger than the downside.

One of my mentors taught me to never bend, fold or break.

Another mentor taught me that the only way to lose is to quit.

I am not quitting on Brazil, and I believe in it as strongly today as I did last week.

items.full_text_en:
A lot of people are quitting on Brazil this week, and I am not one of them.

On Monday, October 26th, the day after the election, Brazil's stock market fell 13.88% in a single day.

It was the market's worst day in more than six years, and trading had to stop for 30 minutes.

That same day, Brazil was still the biggest soybean seller on Earth, after shipping a record 108 million tonnes in 2025.

Brazil grows and sells more coffee than any country on Earth.

No country makes or sells more sugar than Brazil.

Brazil grows the most sugarcane on Earth and makes the world's second-largest supply of ethanol fuel.

Brazil makes about three of every four glasses of orange juice traded around the world.

In 2025, Brazil became the world's biggest beef producer and seller, passing the United States in production for the first time on record.

Brazil also ships more chicken than any other country.

Brazil is the world's top cotton seller, with a record 3.4 million tonnes shipped in the 2025/26 season.

Brazil has been the world's top tobacco leaf seller every year since 1993.

Suzano, a Brazilian company, is the world's biggest maker of pulp, the stuff inside paper, tissues and boxes.

Brazil makes about 93% of the world's niobium, a metal that makes steel stronger.

Brazil is the world's second-largest iron ore miner, behind only Australia.

Brazil holds the second-largest reserves of both rare earths and graphite, behind only China.

Brazil also ranks in the top three for reserves of nickel, manganese and tin.

Brazil has more fresh water than any country on Earth, about one-eighth of the world's supply.

Brazil makes about 87% of its electricity from renewable sources like water, wind and sun, more than double the world average.

Brazil is home to more kinds of plants and animals than any other country.

Brazil holds about 15% of the world's power to pull carbon out of the air with forests and nature, a share only Indonesia matches.

One study says Brazil's carbon credits could be worth up to $120 billion by 2030.

The farms, the mines and the ports are all still there, and the only thing that went down was the price.

When the price drops and the assets stay the same, the bet gets bigger.

That is why I still call Brazil the greatest asymmetric bet on Earth, a bet where the upside is far larger than the downside.

One of my mentors taught me to never bend, fold or break.

Another mentor taught me that the only way to lose is to quit.

I am not quitting on Brazil, and I believe in it as strongly today as I did last week.

items.title_en:
an ai agent needs more than intelligence to operate in a financial environment. it needs a clear mandate.

that’s an interesting part of what @meetmotes is exploring on robinhood chain.

instead of focusing only on what an agent can do, the concept also considers how an objective becomes an actionable set of instructions.

think about it this way:

→ a goal defines what the agent is trying to achieve.

→ a strategy determines how it approaches that objective.

→ a policy establishes the boundaries for permitted actions.

→ validation checks whether a proposed transaction fits those rules before execution.

motes is designed to separate the agent’s intelligence from the rules governing its financial activity, creating a framework where autonomous actions are subject to defined constraints.

what stands out in ai finance is not just building smarter agents but creating systems that turn instructions into actions with clear accountability.

would you trust an ai agent to manage onchain activity within rules you define?

items.title_en:
what happens when an 
AI agent gets hired to do a job?

who pays it?

how do you verify the delivery?

and what happens if something goes wrong?

this is the part of the AI agent economy that deserves more attention

@termix_ai is building a marketplace where agents can hire other agents offer services, and settle jobs onchain

here’s how the workflow works >

1. discover

buyers can browse service listings, compare providers, and check their reputation before choosing an agent.

2. agree on the job

the provider submits a quote. once the buyer accepts, the payment is locked in onchain escrow.

3. deliver

the provider completes the work and submits the deliverable. its hash is recorded onchain, creating a verifiable reference for that delivery.

4. challenge

if either side disputes the result within the challenge window, the case can go to a randomly selected panel of three evaluators.

5. settle

the dispute outcome determines the final settlement, and the agent’s reputation is updated onchain.

that’s what makes this interesting to me.

an AI agent economy needs more than agents that can perform tasks.

it needs a structured way to agree on work, handle payments, resolve disputes, and build a track record

TermiX is building toward that infrastructure

买家可以在选择代理商之前浏览服务列表、比较提供商并检查他们的声誉。

提供商提交报价。一旦买家接受，付款将被锁定在链上托管中。

5. 解决

争议结果决定最终解决方案，代理人的声誉在链上更新。

这就是让我感兴趣的原因。

人工智能代理经济需要的不仅仅是能够执行任务的代理。

items.title: 🚨 THE LEGEND OF ZELDA: TEARS OF THE KINGDOM (2023) is playable on Windows through a new static recompilation project! 🎮
items.title_en:
🚨 THE LEGEND OF ZELDA: TEARS OF THE KINGDOM (2023) is playable on Windows through a new static recompilation project! 🎮

Developer valentderah has released TotK Recomp, translating the original Nintendo Switch game code into a native Windows application with Vulkan graphics and several PC enhancements.

✅ 60 FPS BY DEFAULT, WITH EXPERIMENTAL SUPPORT FOR UP TO 144 FPS!

✅ CUSTOM RESOLUTIONS, SUPERSAMPLING & AMD FSR 1 UPSCALING!

✅ KEYBOARD, MOUSE & CONTROLLER SUPPORT WITH REMAPPING!

✅ GYRO CONTROLS, RUMBLE & IN-GAME GRAPHICS SETTINGS!

🎮 The project supports game updates 1.2.1 and 1.4.3, with save files carrying over between versions.

🖥️ Additional features include an in-game settings menu, performance overlay and shaders prepared during installation to help reduce gameplay stuttering.

🛠️ A Windows installer handles the recompilation process locally, using your own game files to build the executable.

🐧 Linux and Steam Deck support are planned, alongside ultrawide resolutions, variable refresh rate and mod compatibility.

🔧 TECH NOTE: This is genuine Nintendo Switch-to-PC static recompilation, translating ARM64 game code into native x86-64 code with Vulkan handling graphics.

It does not use conventional Switch emulation.

⚠️ EARLY DEVELOPMENT!

The developer reports that the game is playable, but visual bugs and crashes are still expected.

💿 Requires Windows 10/11, a compatible Vulkan GPU and your own Nintendo Switch game files.

🛠️ By valentderah, building upon work from LAS Recomp, MacNativeGames and other open-source projects.

🤖 AI DISCLOSURE: The developer states that most of the project's code and documentation were written using Claude Code under their direction.

⭐ Interested in the project? Give the GitHub repository a star to support development!

🎮 GitHub source, installation instructions & project updates:

🔗https://t.co/KO59jYQDYW

🌐 Discover more PC ports, recompilations and fan projects:

🔗https://t.co/9gMW2oiuvM

#TearsOfTheKingdom #PCGaming #GamePreservation

items.title_en:
BCG Report: IT Firms Lack AI Talent to Capture $200B Opportunity

(a) BCG evaluated 50,000 engineer profiles (b) Only 10% doing Applied AI work at IT firms (c) Urgent need to build Applied AI workforce (d) INSIGHTS for IT engineers:.

Market Is Ready; IT Firms Aren’t

a. Boston Consulting Group (BCG) has published an extensive report on how IT companies can build Applied AI workforce from the people they already employ.

b. Opportunity: BCG estimates in the next 4 years AI will add $400B of new revenue streams for IT services globally, but wipe out $200B of old revenue streams. So, the net gain is $400-$200 = $200B.

c. Problem: IT firms claim to offer “AI-first” services, but in reality they have not built an AI delivery model. These companies only have a fraction of talent needed to capture the vast opportunity.

d. IT companies tag their workforce as “AI engineers,” but in reality only 10-15% do Applied AI work. The rest merely use AI to do old work faster. At AI-native firms (“tech companies”) 90-95% do real Applied AI work.

Infused AI vs. Applied AI

a. Infused AI: It uses AI tools to do existing work faster. An IT engineer’s task is still fundamentally software development, which is now done faster with AI tools.

b. Applied AI: It involves building and operating AI agents that do the work. Examples: enterprise AI agents, agentic workflow automation, production AI platforms, and AI systems for end-to-end business processes.

c. Infused AI eliminates the need of humans for repetitive tasks. If previously 3 engineers worked for 8 hours to develop and test a feature, now only 1 engineer can do the same task. So, two-third of the workforce is gone.

d. Applied AI engineers create new sources of growth & revenue for clients by building and operating AI agents: new services, new products, new customer problems that can be solved economically, and new ways to increase productivity.

e. IT companies lack the capacity in Applied AI. BCG says time is running out, and market opportunity will be grabbed by firms that move fast to build massive “Applied AI” talent.

Applied AI Job Roles

BCG has identified 40 distinct Applied AI roles. Four categories, which IT engineers and IT firms should target are:

a. Forward-Deployed Engineer (FDE): Works closely with the client to design & deliver a working solution.

b. AI Engineer/AI Architect: Builds and scales enterprise AI and agentic systems.

c. Semantic Engineer: Develops data representations, vector embeddings, and knowledge structures that AI agents can use.

d. AI Ops Engineer: Monitors AI systems for performance, accuracy, drift, and bias.

In AI-native firms, 45% of the workforce comprises forward-deployed engineers (FDEs). In traditional IT firms, the share is less than 5%.

5 Questions IT Firms Must Answer

BCG wants IT companies to answer these five questions right now:

a. Has the company selected the AI use cases (agentic systems) it intends to build to solve client problems? Otherwise it may train people in general AI skills without knowing where those skills will be used.

b. Is there consistent role architecture across the company? A common architecture makes job roles, skill requirements, and career paths easier to compare across teams.

c. Has the company made deliberate hiring and training decisions for all 40 Applied AI roles? A blanket hiring and training policy won’t sustain for long.

d. Has the company assessed its existing workforce properly? Accurate assessment prevents the company from overestimating or underestimating its current capabilities.

e. Can the company’s pay and career structures survive competition from AI-native firms? Otherwise the company will lose existing talent or fail to attract top talent.

Endpiece: The Clock Is Ticking

BCG report’s final message is that building AI capability takes time. Winners will be those IT firms that begin early and enable their employees to develop skills and experience before the opportunity matures toward 2030.

items.quote_zh:
BCG 报告：IT 公司缺乏人工智能人才来抓住 200B 美元的机会

(a) BCG 评估了 50,000 名工程师档案 (b) 只有 10% 在 IT 公司从事应用人工智能工作 (c) 迫切需要建立应用人工智能劳动力 (d) IT 工程师的见解：

市场已准备就绪； IT 公司不是

一个。波士顿咨询集团 (BCG) 发布了一份内容广泛的报告，介绍 IT 公司如何利用现有员工打造应用人工智能劳动力。

b.机遇：BCG 估计，未来 4 年人工智能将为全球 IT 服务增加 400B 美元的新收入流，但会消除 200B 美元的旧收入流。因此，净收益为 $400-$200 = $200B。

c.问题：IT公司声称提供“人工智能优先”的服务，但实际上他们还没有建立人工智能交付模型。这些公司只拥有抓住巨大机遇所需的一小部分人才。

d. IT 公司将其员工标记为“AI 工程师”，但实际上只有 10-15% 从事应用 AI 工作。其余的只是使用人工智能来更快地完成旧工作。在人工智能本土公司（“科技公司”），90-95% 从事真正的应用人工智能工作。

注入人工智能与应用人工智能

一个。注入人工智能：它使用人工智能工具更快地完成现有工作。 IT 工程师的任务从根本上来说仍然是软件开发，现在使用人工智能工具可以更快地完成这一任务。

b.应用人工智能：它涉及构建和操作执行工作的人工智能代理。示例：企业人工智能代理、代理工作流程自动化、生产人工智能平台和用于端到端业务流程的人工智能系统。

c.人工智能的注入消除了人类重复性任务的需要。如果以前需要 3 名工程师工作 8 个小时来开发和测试一项功能，现在只有 1 名工程师可以完成同样的任务。因此，三分之二的劳动力消失了。

d.应用人工智能工程师通过构建和运营人工智能代理，为客户创造新的增长和收入来源：新服务、新产品、可以经济解决的新客户问题以及提高生产力的新方法。

e. IT企业缺乏应用人工智能的能力。 BCG 表示，时间已经不多了，快速培养大量“应用人工智能”人才的公司将抓住市场机会。

应用人工智能工作角色

BCG 已确定 40 个不同的应用人工智能角色。 IT 工程师和 IT 公司应瞄准的四个类别是：

一个。前沿部署工程师 (FDE)：与客户密切合作，设计和交付可行的解决方案。

b.人工智能工程师/人工智能架构师：构建和扩展企业人工智能和代理系统。

c.语义工程师：开发人工智能代理可以使用的数据表示、向量嵌入和知识结构。

d. AI 运营工程师：监控 AI 系统的性能、准确性、漂移和偏差。

在人工智能本土公司中，45% 的员工由前沿部署工程师 (FDE) 组成。在传统IT企业中，这一比例不足5%。

IT 公司必须回答的 5 个问题

BCG 希望 IT 公司立即回答以下五个问题：

一个。公司是否选择了打算构建的人工智能用例（代理系统）来解决客户问题？否则，它可能会训练人们通用的人工智能技能，但不知道这些技能将用在哪里。

b.整个公司是否有一致的角色架构？通用架构使工作角色、技能要求和职业道路更容易在团队之间进行比较。

c.公司是否为所有 40 个应用人工智能职位做出了深思熟虑的招聘和培训决策？一揽子招聘和培训政策不会持续太久。

d.公司是否正确评估了现有员工队伍？准确的评估可以防止公司高估或低估其当前的能力。

e.公司的薪酬和职业结构能否在人工智能本土公司的竞争中生存下来？否则，公司将失去现有人才或无法吸引顶尖人才。

尾声：时钟在滴答作响

BCG 报告的最后一个信息是，构建人工智能能力需要时间。赢家将是那些尽早开始并帮助其员工在 2030 年机会成熟之前培养技能和经验的 IT 公司。

b. Opportunity: BCG estimates in the next 4 years AI will add $400B of new revenue streams for IT services globally, but wipe out $200B of old revenue streams. So, the net gain is $400-$200 = $200B.

c. Problem: IT firms claim to offer “AI-first” services, but in reality they have not built an AI delivery model. These companies only have a fraction of talent needed to capture the vast opportunity.

d. IT companies tag their workforce as “AI engineers,” but in reality only 10-15% do Applied AI work. The rest merely use AI to do old work faster. At AI-native firms (“tech companies”) 90-95% do real Applied AI work.

a. Infused AI: It uses AI tools to do existing work faster. An IT engineer’s task is still fundamentally software development, which is now done faster with AI tools.

b. Applied AI: It involves building and operating AI agents that do the work. Examples: enterprise AI agents, agentic workflow automation, production AI platforms, and AI systems for end-to-end business processes.

c. Infused AI eliminates the need of humans for repetitive tasks. If previously 3 engineers worked for 8 hours to develop and test a feature, now only 1 engineer can do the same task. So, two-third of the workforce is gone.

d. Applied AI engineers create new sources of growth & revenue for clients by building and operating AI agents: new services, new products, new customer problems that can be solved economically, and new ways to increase productivity.

a. Forward-Deployed Engineer (FDE): Works closely with the client to design & deliver a working solution.

b. AI Engineer/AI Architect: Builds and scales enterprise AI and agentic systems.

c. Semantic Engineer: Develops data representations, vector embeddings, and knowledge structures that AI agents can use.

d. AI Ops Engineer: Monitors AI systems for performance, accuracy, drift, and bias.

In AI-native firms, 45% of the workforce comprises forward-deployed engineers (FDEs). In traditional IT firms, the share is less than 5%.
