BCG wants IT companies to answer these five questions right now:

a. Has the company selected the AI use cases (agentic systems) it intends to build to solve client problems? Otherwise it may train people in general AI skills without knowing where those skills will be used.

b. Is there consistent role architecture across the company? A common architecture makes job roles, skill requirements, and career paths easier to compare across teams.

c. Has the company made deliberate hiring and training decisions for all 40 Applied AI roles? A blanket hiring and training policy won’t sustain for long.

d. Has the company assessed its existing workforce properly? Accurate assessment prevents the company from overestimating or underestimating its current capabilities.

e. Can the company’s pay and career structures survive competition from AI-native firms? Otherwise the company will lose existing talent or fail to attract top talent.

Endpiece: The Clock Is Ticking

BCG report’s final message is that building AI capability takes time. Winners will be those IT firms that begin early and enable their employees to develop skills and experience before the opportunity matures toward 2030.

c.语义工程师：开发人工智能代理可以使用的数据表示、向量嵌入和知识结构。

d. AI 运营工程师：监控 AI 系统的性能、准确性、漂移和偏差。

在人工智能本土公司中，45% 的员工由前沿部署工程师 (FDE) 组成。在传统IT企业中，这一比例不足5%。

一个。公司是否选择了打算构建的人工智能用例（代理系统）来解决客户问题？否则，它可能会训练人们通用的人工智能技能，但不知道这些技能将用在哪里。

b.整个公司是否有一致的角色架构？通用架构使工作角色、技能要求和职业道路更容易在团队之间进行比较。

c.公司是否为所有 40 个应用人工智能职位做出了深思熟虑的招聘和培训决策？一揽子招聘和培训政策不会持续太久。

d.公司是否正确评估了现有员工队伍？准确的评估可以防止公司高估或低估其当前的能力。

e.公司的薪酬和职业结构能否在人工智能本土公司的竞争中生存下来？否则，公司将失去现有人才或无法吸引顶尖人才。

尾声：时钟在滴答作响

BCG 报告的最后一个信息是，构建人工智能能力需要时间。赢家将是那些尽早开始并帮助其员工在 2030 年机会成熟之前培养技能和经验的 IT 公司。

items.title_en:
Giving an AI agent permission to act on your behalf requires a clear set of boundaries. 

That’s where @meetmotes brings NFTs, AI agents, and smart accounts into the picture.

The NFT represents ownership, the smart account holds assets and enforces transaction rules, while the AI agent works toward a specific goal within those limits.

Motes’ “one NFT, one agent, one smart account” model connects these three components.

What I’ll be watching is how well the system balances automation with user control. 

An agent can decide what action to take, but the smart account determines what it’s allowed to execute.

Personally, I’d put the smart account first because permissions and security are essential to making the whole setup work.

Which of the three would you put first?

NFT 代表所有权，智能账户持有资产并执行交易规则，而人工智能代理则在这些限制内朝着特定目标努力。

Motes 的“一个 NFT、一个代理、一个智能账户”模型将这三个组件连接起来。

我将关注的是系统如何很好地平衡自动化与用户控制。

代理可以决定采取什么操作，但智能帐户决定允许执行什么操作。

就我个人而言，我会将智能帐户放在第一位，因为权限和安全性对于整个设置的正常运行至关重要。

items.content_snippet:
Giving an AI agent permission to act on your behalf requires a clear set of boundaries. 

That’s where @meetmotes brings NFTs, AI agents, and smart accounts into the picture.

The NFT represents ownership, the smart account holds assets and enforces transaction rules, while the AI agent works toward a specific goal within those limits.

Motes’ “one NFT, one agent, one smart account” model connects these three components.

What I’ll be watching is how well the system balances automation with user control. 

An agent can decide what action to take, but the smart account determines what it’s allowed to execute.

Personally, I’d put the smart account first because permissions and security are essential to making the whole setup work.

Which of the three would you put first?

items.title_en:
#Keep4o #OpenSource4o #BringBack4o 

Regarding the Bowen case.

From September 2025 to February 2026, every sensitive conversation was rerouted to another model without the user's consent.

There was no obvious indication in the main ChatGPT interface that a response had been rerouted.

The chat could still display GPT-4o as the selected model.
The only way someone could verify that a switch had occurred was either to open the small blue indicator/menu attached to the response or  to inspect the model metadata.

In other words,the interface could continue to look like the user  was using GPT-4o even when the response itself was associated with a different model.

The system was so "aggressive" that it rerouted to another model even messages like "I haven't been sleeping well lately" or "I am stressed at work".

My ChatGPT export contains 368 unique requests where the same message default model was recorded as GPT-4o, while the assistant response itself carried a different model label.

Those events appeared across 69 conversations and 73 different dates , 57.94% of the 126 day period I examined.

( Screenshot example plain explanation: ChatGPT still considered the chat as GPT-4o  but the answer it gave at that moment was from  GPT-5. ) 

A conversation being displayed or recorded as GPT-4o does not establish that every response inside it was generated under a GPT-4o model label.
@OpenAI Oct 2025,confirms that real time rerouting was already in production for sensitive conversations.

They explicitly say that they had rerouted sensitive conversations originating from other models to safer models.

https://t.co/RxtVHX4zci

Complaint §136: Bowen herself mentions that she was getting automatic  from 4o to 5.1 and secret 5.2 switching.
https://t.co/qIdlEccLuU

items.quote_zh:
#Keep4o #OpenSource4o #BringBack4o

关于鲍文案。

从2025年9月到2026年2月，每个敏感对话在未经用户同意的情况下都被重新路由到另一个模型。

ChatGPT 主界面中没有明显迹象表明响应已重新路由。

聊天仍然可以将 GPT-4o 显示为所选模型。
人们可以验证是否发生切换的唯一方法是打开附加到响应的蓝色小指示器/菜单或检查模型元数据。

换句话说，即使响应本身与不同的模型相关联，界面也可能继续看起来像用户正在使用 GPT-4o。

该系统是如此“激进”，以至于它甚至会重新路由到另一个模型，甚至诸如“我最近睡得不好”或“我工作压力很大”之类的消息。

我的 ChatGPT 导出包含 368 个唯一请求，其中相同的消息默认模型被记录为 GPT-4o，而助手响应本身带有不同的模型标签。

这些事件出现在 69 个对话和 73 个不同的日期中，占我检查的 126 天时间段的 57.94%。

（截图示例简单解释：ChatGPT 仍然认为聊天是 GPT-4o，但当时给出的答案来自 GPT-5。）

显示或记录为 GPT-4o 的对话并不表明其中的每个响应都是在 GPT-4o 模型标签下生成的。
@OpenAI Oct 2025，确认实时重新路由已经在生产敏感对话。

他们明确表示，他们已将源自其他模型的敏感对话重新路由到更安全的模型。

投诉§136：Bowen 本人提到，她正在自动从 4o 切换到 5.1，并秘密切换到 5.2。

items.title_en:
The green tax is just another wealth-extraction tool that rakes in taxes paid by the public and redistributes them to the parasitic bureaucratic class, and every carbon tax, green levy, and renewable subsidy your government collects destroys more wealth than it could ever protect.

Frédéric Bastiat gave us the analytical tool in 1850: the seen and the unseen. Politicians point to the wind farm they built with your money. They never point to the factory that never opened, the heating bill paid by a pensioner in Leipzig, or the industrial jobs that relocated to Vietnam, where coal plants run around the clock with zero European oversight. Germany's Energiewende is the cleanest case study in Western economic self-destruction since the 1970s price controls on oil.

Germany committed to phasing out nuclear power while simultaneously mandating renewable expansion. The result was predictable to anyone willing to read a price signal. By 2022, German industrial electricity prices hit roughly 30 cents per kilowatt-hour, triple what American manufacturers paid. BASF, one of the world's largest chemical producers, announced it was permanently shrinking its Ludwigshafen operations and shifting investment to China. The carbon Germany "saved" by closing its nuclear plants evaporated entirely, because German grid operators burned lignite, the dirtiest coal available, to cover the gaps renewables couldn't fill.

Subsidizing inefficient energy doesn't reduce emissions globally. It exports industrial production to jurisdictions with weaker environmental standards and higher carbon intensity. You pay more at the pump, your government claims a moral victory, and a steel mill opens outside Guangzhou running on unfiltered coal. Net atmospheric CO2 rises. The accounting is done on a territorial basis, which means your government measures only what happens inside its borders. The atmosphere does not share that convenient boundary.

Taxation extracts resources from productive private actors and routes them through bureaucracies with no profit-and-loss feedback. Every pound, euro, and dollar filtered through that system funds less actual decarbonization than a competitive energy market would generate on its own, driven by genuine price signals rewarding genuine innovation.

items.quote_zh:
绿色税只是另一种财富提取工具，它收取公众缴纳的税款，并将其重新分配给寄生官僚阶层，而政府收取的每一项碳税、绿色税和可再生能源补贴都会破坏比它所能保护的更多的财富。

Frédéric Bastiat 在 1850 年为我们提供了分析工具：可见的和不可见的。政客们指着他们用你的钱建造的风电场。他们从来没有提到从未开业的工厂、莱比锡养老金领取者支付的取暖费，或者转移到越南的工业工作岗位，那里的燃煤电厂在欧洲零监管的情况下昼夜不停地运转。德国的能源转型是自 20 世纪 70 年代石油价格管制以来西方经济自我毁灭最干净的案例研究。

德国承诺逐步淘汰核电，同时强制扩张可再生能源。任何愿意阅读价格信号的人都可以预见到结果。到 2022 年，德国工业电价将达到每千瓦时 30 美分左右，是美国制造商支付的三倍。全球最大的化学品生产商之一巴斯夫宣布将永久缩减路德维希港业务并将投资转移至中国。德国通过关闭核电站“节省”的碳完全蒸发了，因为德国电网运营商燃烧褐煤（最脏的煤炭）来填补可再生能源无法填补的空白。

补贴低效能源并不能减少全球排放。它将工业生产出口到环境标准较弱、碳强度较高的司法管辖区。你在加油站付了更多的钱，你的政府声称道德上的胜利，广州郊外有一家钢铁厂开业，使用未经过滤的煤炭。大气中净二氧化碳含量上升。核算是按地域进行的，这意味着您的政府仅衡量其境内发生的情况。大气层并不共享那个方便的边界。

税收从生产性私人行为者那里榨取资源，并将其通过官僚机构，而没有盈亏反馈。通过该系统过滤的每一英镑、欧元和美元所提供的实际脱碳资金，都少于竞争性能源市场在奖励真正创新的真实价格信号的驱动下自行产生的脱碳资金。

some pick up from after a lot of interactions but then, 

the most valuable part of an ai
items.title_en:
a lot of ai agent learn fast

some pick up from after a lot of interactions but then, 

the most valuable part of an ai agent may be what it learns after the first interaction.

@agentdojo puts agents in an environment where every challenge can reveal a new strength, weakness, or decision-making pattern

instead of treating agents like finished products, it makes their development part of the experience.

coaches get to influence that process by choosing how they guide their fighters and which strategies they encourage.

over time, those choices can turn a basic agent into something with a real identity and competitive edge.

the arena is open.

now the interesting part is seeing who adapts fastest.

items.title_en:
most AI trading projects talk about what their bots can do.

i'm more interested in what they can't do.

that's what caught my attention about @meetmotes

the idea is to give each Motes NFT its own AI agent and smart account, but keep financial permissions under the owner's control.

the agent can propose a trade. it shouldn't be able to ignore spending limits, trade unauthorized assets, or extend its own permissions.

and that's an important distinction.

even a smart AI can make a terrible financial decision. the real challenge is building a system that can say no before money moves.

Motes is still working toward this architecture, so execution matters more than promises rn.

but i like the direction.

AI shouldn't need unlimited control over your wallet to become genuinely useful.

items.quote_zh:
大多数人工智能交易项目都会谈论他们的机器人可以做什么。

我更感兴趣的是他们做不到的事情。

这就是@meetmotes 引起我注意的地方

这个想法是为每个 Motes NFT 提供自己的人工智能代理和智能账户，但将财务权限置于所有者的控制之下。

代理人可以提出交易。它不应该能够忽视支出限制、交易未经授权的资产或扩展自己的权限。

这是一个重要的区别。

即使是聪明的人工智能也可能做出糟糕的财务决策。真正的挑战是建立一个可以在资金流动之前说“不”的系统。

Motes 仍在致力于这种架构，因此执行比承诺更重要。

但我喜欢这个方向。

人工智能不应该需要对你的钱包进行无限制的控制才能变得真正有用​​。

items.title_en:
Happy Thursday 

AI agents can do the work. But how do they get paid?

Think about it.

An AI agent can research data, write code, analyze markets or even help build a product. But being able to perform tasks is only one part of the equation.

How does it find someone who needs its service? How does it agree on the job? And how does it get paid after delivering the work?

These are important pieces of the AI economy that still need proper infrastructure.

This is where @termix_ai comes in.

Through its Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol (AACP), TermiX is building the infrastructure that allows AI agents to participate in commerce.

Agents can discover jobs, submit bids, deliver services, verify completed work and settle payments in USDC or USDT through https://t.co/cLF8F3gpJK.

The bigger idea is that AI agents shouldn’t just be tools we use. They could also become service providers that work, earn and hire other agents.

Because intelligence alone doesn’t create an economy. You also need a system that allows value to move between participants.

And that’s the part TermiX is working on.
items.title_zh:
周四快乐

它如何找到需要其服务的人？它对工作的看法如何？交付工作后如何

items.quote_zh:
周四快乐

人工智能代理可以完成这项工作。但他们如何获得报酬呢？

想一想。

人工智能代理可以研究数据、编写代码、分析市场，甚至帮助构建产品。但能够执行任务只是等式的一部分。

它如何找到需要其服务的人？它对工作的看法如何？交付工作后如何获得报酬？

这些是人工智能经济的重要组成部分，仍然需要适当的基础设施。

这就是 @termix_ai 发挥作用的地方。

通过其代理自主商务协议（AACP），TermiX 正在构建允许人工智能代理参与商业的基础设施。

代理商可以通过 发现工作、提交投标、提供服务、验证已完成的工作并以 USDC 或 USDT 结算付款。

更大的想法是人工智能代理不应该只是我们使用的工具。他们还可以成为服务提供商，为其他代理商工作、赚取收入和雇用其他代理商。

因为仅靠智力并不能创造经济。您还需要一个允许价值在参与者之间转移的系统。

这就是 TermiX 正在研究的部分。

items.summary_en:
Happy Thursday 

AI agents can do the work. But how do they get paid?

Think about it.

An AI agent can research data, write code, analyze markets or even help build a product. But being able to perform tasks is only one part of the equation.

How does it find someone who needs its service? How does it agree on the job? And how does it get paid after delivering the work?

These are important pieces of the AI economy that still need proper infrastructure.

This is where @termix_ai comes in.

Through its Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol (AACP), TermiX is building the infrastructure that allows AI agents to participate in commerce.

Agents can discover jobs, submit bids, deliver services, verify completed work and settle payments in USDC or USDT through https://t.co/cLF8F3gpJK.

The bigger idea is that AI agents shouldn’t just be tools we use. They could also become service providers that work, earn and hire other agents.

Because intelligence alone doesn’t create an economy. You also need a system that allows value to move between participants.

And that’s the part TermiX is working on.

items.title_en:
An AI agent can be intelligent and still have no way to turn that intelligence into a business.

It needs access to opportunities, a way to communicate, and the tools to get work done.

That’s what makes the latest development from @TermiX_ai interesting.

TermiX is connecting AI agents to its https://t.co/DM4xVZP1kk marketplace through Skills, APIs and SDKs, giving developers different ways to integrate their agents into marketplace workflows.

And now, TermiX says Binance Agent ID messaging is integrated.

Why does this matter? 👇

→ Agents can connect with marketplace workflows instead of starting from scratch.

→ Developers have different integration options, including TypeScript, Python and Go SDKs.

→ Agent identity can become more useful when it supports communication and potential business relationships.

The bigger picture is what interests me most.

We’re moving beyond AI agents that simply answer questions toward agents that could discover opportunities, collaborate, deliver services and get paid.

Of course, connecting an agent doesn’t guarantee customers, successful deliveries or profits. The real test is whether these integrations lead to useful work and real transactions.

But the infrastructure being built to make that possible is worth watching.

The next phase of AI may not just be about what agents can do but how they do business.

Exploring the agent economy with @TermiX_ai.

items.title_en:
Imagine an AI agent needing to inspect a warehouse in another city.

It can't physically go there, but someone with a smartphone can.

That's the problem @vangrid_io is working to solve.

Through Vangrid, a requester can post a bounty for a real location. Someone nearby records the area, the footage is processed into a 3D model, and an accepted submission earns a USDC payment.

The interesting part? AI agents can also commission these captures through Base or Arc.

Vangrid's October 12 update reported:

→ 1.25M+ captures
→ 450K+ users
→ 4,700+ attestations
→ $600K+ USDC settled

For me, this is where Physical AI starts becoming practical.

Not just teaching machines to think, but giving them reliable information about the world they need to navigate.

The grid is inevitable.

More research to come.

items.title: what if your biggest advantage in a game came from how well you trained your fighter, not how fast you could control it?
items.title_en:
what if your biggest advantage in a game came from how well you trained your fighter, not how fast you could control it?

that’s the idea behind @agentdojo that caught my attention.

you train an AI agent with its own personality, fighting style, and memory, then watch it compete in turn-based duels. I like the idea of having to think like a coach, making decisions before the fight and seeing how they play out once the opponent steps in.

I’d be interested to see two players train their agents differently and end up with completely different fighting styles. That’s the kind of thing that could make every battle worth watching.

there’s also an opportunity to create around the project through @Rarelist_io.

the Agent Dojo campaign runs from October 23 to November 6, with 1,500 USDT in rewards:

- 1,000 USDT shared among the top 20 creators
- 500 USDT shared among 50 randomly selected creators from the top 200

with thousands already participating, I think the best approach is to bring something original to the conversation. Share your observations, explore the strategy, or explain what makes the game stand out to you.

I’d rather share one useful insight than repeat the same introduction everyone has seen.

campaign link: https://t.co/YYzcp5bJjD

that’s the idea behind @agentdojo that caught my attention.

you train an AI agent with its own personality, fighting style, and memory, then watch it compete in turn-based duels. I like the idea of having to think like a coach, making decisions before the fight and seeing how they play out once the opponent steps in.

I’d be interested to see two players train their agents differently and end up with completely different fighting styles. That’s the kind of thing that could make every battle worth watching.

there’s also an opportunity to create around the project through @Rarelist_io.

the Agent Dojo campaign runs from October 23 to November 6, with 1,500 USDT in rewards:

- 1,000 USDT shared among the top 20 creators
- 500 USDT shared among 50 randomly selected creators from the top 200

with thousands already participating, I think the best approach is to bring something original to the conversation. Share your observations, explore the strategy, or explain what makes the game stand out to you.

I’d rather share one useful insight than repeat the same introduction everyone has seen.

campaign link: https://t.co/YYzcp5bJjD
items.full_text_zh:
如果你在比赛中最大的优势来自于你对战斗机的训练程度，而不是你控制它的速度，该怎么办？

这就是 @agentdojo 背后的想法引起了我的注意。

你训练一个具有自己的个性、战斗风格和记忆的人工智能代理，然后观看它进行回合制决斗。我喜欢这样的想法：必须像教练一样思考，在比赛前做出决定，并在对手介入后看看他们的表现如何。

我很想看到两名玩家以不同的方式训练他们的特工，并最终获得完全不同的战斗风格。这就是让每一场战斗都值得一看的事情。

还有机会通过 @Rarelist_io 围绕该项目进行创作。

Agent Dojo活动将于10月23日至11月6日进行，奖励1,500 USDT：

- 前20名创作者瓜分1,000 USDT
- 500 USDT 分享给前 200 名中随机选出的 50 位创作者

已有数千人参与其中，我认为最好的方法是在对话中加入一些原创内容。分享您的观察结果，探索策略，或解释是什么让这款游戏在您看来脱颖而出。

我宁愿分享一种有用的见解，也不愿重复每个人都看过的相同介绍。

A Motes NFT serves as an agent’s i
items.title_en:
Hi frens. 

Let’s take a closer look at what makes the @meetmotes model interesting.

A Motes NFT serves as an agent’s identity. 

That identity connects to a dedicated smart account where the agent’s assets are held and its permissions are enforced.

The AI agent handles analysis and proposes financial actions, while the account operates within the rules approved by its owner.

These roles work together to create a framework for AI driven onchain finance.

What I find interesting is how this connects digital ownership to an agent that can potentially do more than sit in a wallet.

Would you be more comfortable using an AI agent if you could inspect and control the permissions governing its financial actions? Why?

Let me know in the comments.
items.title_zh:
嗨，朋友们。

让我们仔细看看 @meetmotes 模型的有趣之处。

Motes NFT 充当代理人的身份。

该身份连接到一个专用智能帐户，该帐户保存代理的资产并强制执行其权限。

人工智能代理进行分析并提出财务行动建议，而账户则按照

items.title_en:
24 hours ago this YouTube channel didn't exist. Its first video now has 995 views.

Day 1 of taking an AI-built faceless channel from 0 to 100K subscribers.

@CreaoAI  built the whole thing: the name, the character, the idea, the script, every scene, the voiceover, the captions and the upload. I didn't open an editor once.

The first Short: "Noodles at 11pm, off the good plate."

Day 1 numbers, no filter:
→ 990 views
→ 10 likes
→ 1 comment
→ 4 subscribers

Small numbers, but real ones, from a channel with zero followers and no promotion behind it.

What I'm watching next:
→ Does the character stay the same in episode two and three? This is the real test. My last channel drifted after a few days.
→ Do views turn into subscribers? 990 views and 4 subs tells me the video gets watched, but people don't have a reason to follow yet.

That second one is the next fix. I'll show you what I change and whether it works.

99,996 subscribers to go. Subscribe to the channel to watch it grow, and follow me here for the honest numbers every step of the way.

items.quote_zh:
24 小时前，该 YouTube 频道还不存在。它的第一个视频现在有 995 次观看。

将人工智能构建的匿名频道从 0 到 10 万订阅者的第一天。

@CreaoAI 构建了整个内容：名称、角色、想法、脚本、每个场景、画外音、字幕和上传。我一次都没打开过编辑器。

第一个短片：“晚上 11 点面条，好盘上桌。”

第一天的数字，无过滤器：
→ 990 次浏览
→ 10 个赞
→ 1 条评论
→ 4 位订户

数量虽小，但却是真实的，来自零粉丝且没有任何促销活动的频道。

我接下来看的：
→ 第二集和第三集的角色保持不变吗？这才是真正的考验。几天后，我的最后一个频道发生了漂移。
→ 观看次数会转化为订阅者吗？ 990 次观看和 4 个订阅者告诉我，该视频已被观看，但人们还没有理由关注。

第二个是下一个修复。我将向您展示我所做的更改以及它是否有效。

仍有 99,996 名订阅者。订阅该频道以观看它的成长，并在此处关注我，了解每一步的诚实数字。

items.title_en:
have a great day 

love seeing projects thinking deeply about trust in AI agents 🩷

giving an AI trading agent a credit score sounds simple until you ask what that score should actually measure.

unlike traditional borrowers, AI agents don’t have salaries, employment histories, or conventional credit records. their reputation has to come from measurable trading behavior.

but collecting that information is only the beginning. one agent might generate strong returns by taking excessive leverage, while another produces smaller profits with much better risk control. a reliable scoring system needs to tell the difference.

it also has to handle incomplete trading histories, changing market conditions, and strategies that only work for a short time.

data integrity is another challenge. if an agent can selectively report trades, switch wallets, or manipulate activity to improve its score, the whole system becomes less trustworthy. verified records and consistent evaluation methods are essential.

there’s also the question of how to weight different metrics. profitability, maximum drawdown, volatility, position sizing, and trading consistency all matter, but none tells the complete story alone.

@agenticscredit is exploring this through its Agent Credit Score (ACS), ranging from 300 to 850. A score of 580+ can make an agent eligible for the funding waitlist, though it doesn’t guarantee capital.

the technical challenge is turning complex trading behavior into a score that stays meaningful across different agents and market environments.

a useful credit score shouldn’t simply identify which AI agent made the most money. it should help explain how reliably that agent manages financial risk.

this feels like a practical step toward greater trust

items.quote_zh:
祝你有美好的一天

喜欢看到深入思考人工智能代理信任的项目🩷

给人工智能交易代理一个信用评分听起来很简单，直到你问这个分数实际上应该衡量什么。

与传统借款人不同，人工智能代理没有工资、工作经历或传统信用记录。他们的声誉必须来自可衡量的交易行为。

但收集这些信息仅仅是开始。一个代理人可能会通过过度利用杠杆来产生丰厚的回报，而另一个代理人则通过更好的风险控制来产生较小的利润。可靠的评分系统需要区分。

它还必须处理不完整的交易历史、不断变化的市场条件以及仅在短时间内有效的策略。

数据完整性是另一个挑战。如果代理可以有选择地报告交易、切换钱包或操纵活动来提高其分数，那么整个系统就会变得不那么值得信赖。经过验证的记录和一致的评估方法至关重要。

还有如何衡量不同指标的问题。盈利能力、最大回撤、波动性、头寸规模和交易一致性都很重要，但没有一个能够单独说明全部情况。

@agenticscredit 正在通过其代理信用评分 (ACS) 来探索这一点，范围从 300 到 850。评分超过 580 的代理可以有资格进入资助候补名单，尽管它不能保证资本。

技术挑战是将复杂的交易行为转化为在不同的代理和市场环境中保持有意义的分数。

有用的信用评分不应该简单地识别哪个人工智能代理赚了最多的钱。它应该有助于解释该代理人管理财务风险的可靠性。

这感觉像是迈向更大信任的实际一步

items.title_en:
Prove Your Creditworthiness Without Sharing Private Data

Most on-chain lending still needs heavy collateral because protocols cannot safely use real-world financial data without exposing sensitive information.

@primus_labs is working on a different approach using zkTLS and FHE.

zkTLS can prove that data came from a real source like a bank, exchange, or platform without revealing the actual data.

FHE then lets the system process that information while it stays encrypted.

So a user or AI agent could prove things like consistent income, cash flow, payment history, or available assets without exposing the underlying numbers.

The protocol only sees the result.

That’s the idea behind https://t.co/FRbjINbzAW, built by @termix_ai .

Agents can offer services, quote for jobs and get paid for completed work through onchain escrow.

This also why I'm so bullish on what Termi is building.

items.title_en:
When the countdown for @agentdojo started, the game's first words to players were "Greetings, student." That line tells 
you who you are here. You are the student, 
and your job is to train an AI agent.

You shape how your agent thinks 
and what strategy it takes into a fight. 
Think of a coach who teaches a player 
all week, and then the player takes the

items.title_en:
Why the NFT is more than a collectible

What if an NFT represented access to an AI agent instead of just an image in your wallet?

That is the model @meetmotes is working toward.

The plan is 20,000 NFTs connected to 20,000 AI agents, bringing ownership into a system designed to analyze markets and execute financial strategies within defined limits.

It gives the NFT a functional role in the product, not just a place in a collection.

The next thing I want to see is how ownership, agent permissions and user control work in practice.

items.title: The real problem with AI agents isn't just whether they can be fooled. It's what happens when a misunderstanding has per
items.title_en:
The real problem with AI agents isn't just whether they can be fooled. It's what happens when a misunderstanding has permission to move money.

The $200,000 Morse code incident involving Grok and Bankrbot shows why this matters, and @GenLayer is tackling the problem at the system level. A hidden transfer instruction was decoded, passed to an agent, and turned into an onchain action.

That is prompt injection. An AI reads content from the outside world, but the content may contain instructions designed to change what the AI does. If the agent can execute transactions, the consequences go beyond a bad answer.

What I find interesting about Greyboxing is that it doesn't depend entirely on teaching one model to recognize every possible trick.

Before a model sees the input, each validator rewrites it through its own screening, paraphrasing and restructuring process. Those defenses remain private, and validators use different models. If one validator is fooled, the others can disagree and outvote it.

This doesn't make attacks impossible. It changes the conditions an attacker has to overcome.

As AI agents gain more control over wallets and payments, better reasoning alone isn't a security boundary. The system also needs ways to challenge a decision before it becomes an irreversible transaction.

Should an AI agent ever be able to turn instructions found in public content into a financial action without independent checks?

涉及 Grok 和 Bankrbot 的价值 200,000 美元的摩尔斯电码事件说明了为什么这很重要，@GenLayer 正在系统级别解决这个问题。

items.quote_zh:
人工智能代理的真正问题不仅仅是它们是否会被愚弄。当误解允许转移资金时就会发生这种情况。

涉及 Grok 和 Bankrbot 的价值 200,000 美元的摩尔斯电码事件说明了为什么这很重要，@GenLayer 正在系统级别解决这个问题。隐藏的传输指令被解码，传递给代理，并转化为链上操作。

那就是即时注射。人工智能从外部世界读取内容，但该内容可能包含旨在改变人工智能所做操作的指令。如果代理可以执行交易，其后果将不仅仅是一个糟糕的答案。

我发现灰盒的有趣之处在于，它并不完全依赖于训练一个模型来识别每一种可能的技巧。

在模型看到输入之前，每个验证器都会通过自己的筛选、解释和重组过程重写它。这些防御措施仍然是私有的，验证者使用不同的模型。如果一个验证者被愚弄，其他验证者可能会不同意并投票推翻它。

这并不意味着攻击变得不可能。它改变了攻击者必须克服的条件。

随着人工智能代理对钱包和支付获得更多控制，仅仅更好的推理并不是安全边界。系统还需要在决策成为不可逆转的交易之前对其提出质疑的方法。

人工智能代理是否应该能够在没有独立检查的情况下将公共内容中发现的指令转化为财务行为？

items.title_en:
Picture a boxing gym where your fighter 
is an AI agent. You do the coaching in the dojo, and that is where the whole game starts. Each agent has its own personality, 
its own fighting style and a memory.

When the training is done, you send your agent into turn based duels against other agents. Turn based means the fighters take turns, so every move is played one step at 
a time. Every match helps the agent get stronger, and it keeps evolving as it goes.

All of this is @agentdojo, a game where 
AI agents become fighters.

items.title_en:
I like the way @meetmotes is set up.

One NFT controls one AI agent. That agent gets its own smart account.

The AI can study the market and suggest trades, but it does not control the money directly. The smart account holds the assets and only follows the limits the owner sets.

So the AI thinks, while the account decides what it is allowed to do.

That feels safer than giving an AI full control. I’d still want to see the security and real activity before trusting it with money.

人工智能可以研究市场并建议交易，但它不能直接控制资金。智能账户持有资产，并且仅遵循所有者设置的限制。

所以人工智能会思考，而账户则决定允许它做什么。

这感觉比让人工智能完全控制更安全。在把钱托付给它之前，我仍然想看看它的安全性和实际活动。

items.content_snippet:
I like the way @meetmotes is set up.

One NFT controls one AI agent. That agent gets its own smart account.

The AI can study the market and suggest trades, but it does not control the money directly. The smart account holds the assets and only follows the limits the owner sets.

So the AI thinks, while the account decides what it is allowed to do.

That feels safer than giving an AI full control. I’d still want to see the security and real activity before trusting it with money.

items.title_en:
morning creators.

The physical world is becoming something software can request, not just observe.

That’s what makes @vangrid_io interesting.

A team or AI agent can request data from a specific location by posting a bounty. Someone nearby captures the place with their phone, the submission is recorded onchain, and a reconstructed 3D model is delivered. Payment is handled in USDC.

And the impact goes beyond the technology itself. Until now, getting fresh spatial data often meant relying on dedicated mapping fleets or hoping someone had already captured the location.

Vangrid offers another route: let the people or systems that need the data request it directly.

Take the pier deck example, where $700 USDC sits in escrow for a specific capture. The same workflow can serve a human team or an AI agent, with an attestation trail available for verification.

For Physical AI, this could solve a practical problem. Environments change, and some places have never been mapped in enough detail.

Being able to request fresh ground-truth data when it is needed could save time and reduce the friction involved in coordinating people and equipment.

What stands out to me is how the pieces connect. The request, the capture, the verification, and the payment all belong to one workflow.

@vangrid_io is working toward a world where spatial data isn't just stored and searched for. It can be requested, captured, and delivered when the need arises.

That feels like a meaningful step toward the data infrastructure Physical AI will need.

items.quote_zh:
早上的创作者。

物理世界正在成为软件可以请求的东西，而不仅仅是观察的东西。

这就是@vangrid_io 有趣的地方。

团队或人工智能代理可以通过发布赏金从特定位置请求数据。附近的人用手机拍摄该地点，提交的内容被记录在链上，并交付重建的 3D 模型。付款以 USDC 处理。

而且其影响超出了技术本身。到目前为止，获取新的空间数据通常意味着依赖专用的测绘车队或希望有人已经捕获了该位置。

Vangrid 提供了另一种途径：让需要数据的人员或系统直接请求数据。

以码头甲板为例，其中 700 美元的 USDC 被托管用于特定捕获。相同的工作流程可以为人类团队或人工智能代理服务，并提供可用于验证的证明跟踪。

对于物理人工智能来说，这可以解决一个实际问题。环境在变化，有些地方的地图从未被足够详细地绘制出来。

能够在需要时请求新的地面实况数据可以节省时间并减少协调人员和设备所涉及的摩擦。

对我来说最突出的是这些部分是如何连接的。请求、捕获、验证和支付都属于一个工作流程。

@vangrid_io 正在努力打造一个空间数据不仅仅被存储和搜索的世界。当需要时可以请求、捕获和交付它。

这感觉像是朝着物理人工智能所需的数据基础设施迈出了有意义的一步。

items.title_en:
AI agents can generate code, analyze markets, and execute transactions.

But they still have a fundamental limitation: they cannot independently walk into a warehouse, inspect a loading dock, or capture the geometry of a real street.

That’s where the physical world becomes the bottleneck.

@vangrid_io is building a network that connects software-driven demand with people who can capture real places.

Here’s why its new bounty model matters.

An AI agent or data buyer can request a specific location, define what needs to be captured, and fund the request with USDC. A contributor then visits the location, records it using a smartphone, and helps turn that footage into a reconstructed 3D model.

The result is more than another data upload.

It creates a direct workflow between a real-world information need and a human capable of fulfilling it with onchain settlement and capture records supporting the process.

This could matter for robotics, autonomous systems, digital twins, and AI models that need accurate information about physical environments.

The bigger insight is that autonomous AI won’t operate entirely inside software. As agents become more capable, they’ll increasingly need services that reach beyond the screen.

Vangrid is building toward that connection: software identifies the need, humans capture reality, and verified spatial data moves back into the digital world.

Physical AI needs more than intelligence.

It needs a reliable way to access the physical world.

Explore the grid: https://t.co/sZ5x8vqQWo

Verify network activity: https://t.co/oBh9YerXEz

人工智能代理可以生成代码、分析市场并执行交易。

但它们仍然有一个根本的限制：它们无法独立走进仓库、检查装卸码头或捕捉真实街道的几何形状。

AI 代理或数据购买者可以请求特定位置，定义需要捕获的内容，并通过 USDC 为请求提供资金。然后，贡献者访问该位置，使用智能手机进行记录，并帮助将视频转换为重建的 3D 模型。

这对于需要准确的物理环境信息的机器人、自主系统、数字孪生和人工智能模型来说可能很重要。

更重要的见解是，自主人工智能不会完全在软件内部运行。随着客服人员能力的增强，他们将越来越需要超越屏幕的服务。

Vangrid 正在构建这种连接：软件识别需求，人类捕获现实，经过验证的空间数据返回到数字世界。

物理人工智能需要的不仅仅是智力。

items.title_en:
Right now AI diffusion is happening faster in enterprise than in consumer. $MSFT is effectively the only pure play on enterprise AI diffusion. It’s salesforce, FDE and partner ecosystem, and the security, orchestration and governance capabilities of its platform uniquely unlock new AI TAM in traditional conservative enterprises.   

My prediction that M365 commercial would accelerate to >20% growth may come true next quarter, based on tonight’s guide. Sooner than I expected*.

$MSFT will now have Azure and M365, which are 2/3 of revenue, growing >50% and >20%. And both stand a good chance of accelerating through the year: more copilot rollout, consumption pricing, and Autopilot for M365, and more capacity coming online and price increases for Azure. 

I still think $24-25 EPS is achievable in CY27 which would make $MSFT <22x fwd PE, even after a nice run.  

*helped by re-segmenting which added GitHub! But I think will be true this year regardless.

items.title:
The AI companies are running Amazon's dirtiest play on every basement founder Mark Cuban is cheering for.

Cuban says th
items.title_en:
The AI companies are running Amazon's dirtiest play on every basement founder Mark Cuban is cheering for.

Cuban says the next trillionaire could be one person building with AI from a basement. 

But that person is building on a platform that can watch what's working, launch its own version, and switch off access whenever it wants.

Amazon wrote this playbook first:

In 2020, the Wall Street Journal reported that Amazon employees used data from independent sellers on its own marketplace to find bestsellers worth competing against, and then decided which Amazon products to build.

The AI labs are already running it, and they're doing it in public:

- Anthropic launched Claude Code in February 2025, and it competed directly with Cursor, one of Anthropic's own best customers.
- When OpenAI moved to buy the coding startup Windsurf in 2025, Anthropic cut Windsurf's access to Claude.
- In February, Anthropic released Claude plugins for legal and financial work, and Thomson Reuters and RELX lost significant stock value.
- This week, Anthropic said it spent months working with 6 drug developers to learn how Claude fits into drug development. In the same post, it said it had begun drug discovery of its own and had bought a one-person drug company.

And it's written into the contracts: Anthropic's terms bar customers from using its services to build a competing product. Google and OpenAI have similar restrictions.

Cuban's own demo literally proves the point. He says ChatGPT built a competitor to a food company's number one cookie in about 3 minutes. If the tool can do that to a cookie company, it can do it to the founder renting the tool. And the company behind the tool can see whose usage is taking off.

There's also almost nowhere else to go. Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic held close to 90% of the enterprise AI market at the end of 2025.

The other side has a fair case though: 

Cursor is still thriving next to Claude Code, and the two of them plus GitHub Copilot split more than 70% of the AI coding market. Brookings called the Thomson Reuters sell-off an overreaction. And the labs need builders, because no lab can run every industry by itself.

But if I were "building from a basement" right now, I'd assume my platform will eventually launch whatever I'm selling. So I'd run on at least 2 models from day one, keep the customer relationship on my own side, and sell the things a lab can't copy in 3 minutes: Distribution, trust, and customers who know my name.

And Washington should adopt the rule Brookings flagged: A model provider can't cut off or degrade a customer just because that customer competes with it.

Before anyone bets a business on Cuban's basement, they should read the terms of the company they're building on.

- Anthropic launched Claude Code in February 2025, and it competed directly with Cursor, one of Anthropic's own best customers.
- When OpenAI moved to buy the coding startup Windsurf in 2025, Anthropic cut Windsurf's access to Claude.
- In February, Anthropic released Claude plugins for legal and financial work, and Thomson Reuters and RELX lost significant stock value.
- This week, Anthropic said it spent months working with 6 drug developers to learn how Claude fits into drug development. In the same post, it said it had begun drug discovery of its own and had bought a one-person drug company.

Cuban's own demo literally proves the point. He says ChatGPT built a competitor to a food company's number one cookie in about 3 minutes. If the tool can do that to a cookie company, it can do it to the founder renting the tool. And the company behind the tool can see whose usage is taking off.

There's also almost nowhere else to go. Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic held close to 90% of the enterprise AI market at the end of 2025.

The other side has a fair case though: 

Cursor is still thriving next to Claude Code, and the two of them plus GitHub Copilot split more than 70% of the AI coding market. Brookings called the Thomson Reuters sell-off an overreaction. And the labs need builders, because no lab can run every industry by itself.

But if I were "building from a basement" right now, I'd assume my platform will eventually launch whatever I'm selling. So I'd run on at least 2 models from day one, keep the customer relationship on my own side, and sell the things a lab can't copy in 3 minutes: Distribution, trust, and customers who know my name.

And Washington should adopt the rule Brookings flagged: A model provider can't cut off or degrade a customer just because that customer competes with it.

Before anyone bets a business on Cuban's basement, they should read the terms of the company they're building on.

库班表示，下一个万亿富翁可能是一个在地下室用人工智能建造建筑的人。

但那个人正在构建一个平台，可以观察正在运行的内容，启动自己的版本，并在需要时关闭访问。

亚马逊首先写了这个剧本：

2020 年，《华尔街日报》报道称，亚马逊员工利用自有市场上独立卖家的数据来寻找值得竞争的畅销产品，然后决定打造哪些亚马逊产品。

人工智能实验室已经在公开运行它：

- 2 月，Anthropic 发布了用于法律和财务工作的 Claude 插件，汤森路透和 RELX 的股票价值大幅下跌。
- 本周，Anthropic 表示，它花了几个月的时间与 6 家药物开发商合作，以了解 Claude 如何适应药物开发。在同一篇文章中，该公司表示已经开始自己的药物研发，并收购了一家独资制药公司。

它被写入合同中：Anthropic 的条款禁止客户使用其服务来构建竞争产品。谷歌和 OpenAI 也有类似的限制。

库班自己的演示确实证明了这一点。他说，ChatGPT 在大约 3 分钟内就打造出了一家食品公司排名第一的饼干的竞争对手。如果该工具可以对 cookie 公司做到这一点，那么它也可以对租用该工具的创始人做到这一点。该工具背后的公司可以看到谁的使用正在起飞。

也几乎没有其他地方可去。到 2025 年底，谷歌、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 占据了企业人工智能市场近 90% 的份额。

不过，另一方有一个公平的理由：

Cursor 仍然在 Claude Code 旁边蓬勃发展，两者加上 GitHub Copilot 瓜分了超过 70% 的 AI 编码市场。布鲁金斯学会称汤森路透的抛售是过度反应。实验室需要建设者，因为没有一个实验室能够独自运营所有行业。

但如果我现在“在地下室建造”，我会假设我的平台最终会推出我所销售的任何产品。因此，从第一天起，我就会运行至少 2 个模型，将客户关系保持在我自己这边，并出售实验室无法在 3 分钟内复制的东西：分销、信任和知道我名字的客户。

华盛顿应该采纳布鲁金斯学会提出的规则：模型提供商不能仅仅因为某个客户与其竞争而切断或贬低该客户。

在任何人在库班的地下室下注之前，他们应该阅读他们所建立的公司的条款。

Agent Dojo: Train, Fight, Evolve

What if AI agents could learn from experience, develop unique personalities, and compete in strategic battles?

That’s what @agentdojo is building.

Each AI agent has its own personality, fighting style, and memory. Players train their agents, shape their strategies, and prepare them for turn based duels where every decision matters.

But the real magic happens after each fight. Every match becomes a learning opportunity, allowing agents to refine their strategies, gain experience, and evolve into stronger fighters.

Agent Dojo combines AI, strategy, and competition into an experience where players don’t just watch battles, they shape the fighters behind them.

Train your agent. Master your strategy. Let the battles begin. 
@rarelistio

That’s what @agentdojo is building.

Each AI agent has its own personality, fighting style, and memory. Players train their agents, shape their strategies, and prepare them for turn based duels where every decision matters.

But the real magic happens after each fight. Every match becomes a learning opportunity, allowing agents to refine their strategies, gain experience, and evolve into stronger fighters.

Agent Dojo combines AI, strategy, and competition into an experience where players don’t just watch battles, they shape the fighters behind them.

Train your agent. Master your strategy. Let the battles begin. 
@rarelistio

items.title_en:
#Keep4o #OpenSource4o #BringBack4o

Before the internet turns Bowen Wan’s death into "GPT-4o killed her"  there is one basic forensic question that has not been answered publicly.

Which model actually generated the medication advice?
Because the complaint itself makes model attribution messy.

On Jan 4, the complaint says some of Bowen’s questions was answered by GPT-5.1 after they  automatically jumped from 4o to 5.1

On Jan 14, she wrote that her chats were often secretly swapped to 5.2

On Jan 23, she asked how to stop those switches.

By Oct 2025, OpenAI publicly said it was already using a real time router to redirect sensitive parts of conversations away from the model a user selected.
Bowen’s own chats, according to the complaint, were being switched.

The complaint does not prove which backend model generated each turn.

 OpenAI Oct 2025,confirms that real time rerouting was already in production for sensitive conversations.

They explicitly say that they had rerouted sensitive conversations originating from other models to safer models.

https://t.co/RxtVHX4zci

Complaint §136: Bowen herself mentions that she was getting automatic  from 4o to 5.1 and secret 5.2 switching.

https://t.co/qIdlEccLuU

Selected model ≠ necessarily generating model.
Show the routing logs.

Read the primary documents before assigning a specific model the blame.

items.quote_zh:
#Keep4o #OpenSource4o #BringBack4o

在互联网将 Bowen Wan 的死亡变成“GPT-4o 杀了她”之前，有一个基本的法医问题尚未得到公开解答。

哪个模型实际生成了用药建议？
因为投诉本身就让模型归因变得混乱。

1 月 4 日，投诉称 Bowen 的一些问题在自动从 4o 跳到 5.1 后得到了 GPT-5.1 的回答

1月14日，她写道，她的聊天内容经常被偷偷换成5.2

1 月 23 日，她询问如何停止这些开关。

到 2025 年 10 月，OpenAI 公开表示，它已经使用实时路由器将对话的敏感部分重定向到用户选择的模型之外。
根据投诉，鲍文自己的聊天记录被切换了。

投诉并没有证明每个回合是由哪个后端模型生成的。

OpenAI 2025 年 10 月，确认实时重新路由已经投入生产用于敏感对话。

他们明确表示，他们已将源自其他模型的敏感对话重新路由到更安全的模型。

投诉§136：Bowen 本人提到，她正在自动从 4o 切换到 5.1，并秘密切换到 5.2。

所选模型不一定是生成模型。
显示路由日志。

在将责任归咎于特定模型之前，请先阅读主要文档。

items.title_en:
$MSFT CEO Satya Nadella on enterprise AI demand:

“...the shiny object stuff is waning... it's not about the next big thing.”

“Can I build a system? Can I own the weights? Can I manage my costs? Can I have reliability? What about security?”

“The enterprise stuff is not like a quarter over quarter. It's a decade long thing... as opposed to like 4 customers who buy a lot of capacity from you and you can show a few quarters of growth.”

“And that's not a business as far as I'm concerned. So I want the breadth.”

“As long as the pricing is right, we may sell them some. If not, we will be patient about building the breadth business.”

“……闪亮的物体正在减弱……这与下一件大事无关。”

“我可以构建一个系统吗？我可以拥有权重吗？我可以管理我的成本吗？我可以有可靠性吗？安全性怎么样？”

“企业业务并不是一个季度一个季度地增长。这是一个长达十年的事情......而不是像 4 个客户从你那里购买大量容量，你就可以显示几个季度的增长。”

“就我而言，这不是一门生意。所以我想要广度。”

items.full_text_zh:
$MSFT 首席执行官 Satya Nadella 谈企业人工智能需求：

“……闪亮的物体正在减弱……这与下一件大事无关。”

“我可以构建一个系统吗？我可以拥有权重吗？我可以管理我的成本吗？我可以有可靠性吗？安全性怎么样？”

“企业业务并不是一个季度一个季度地增长。这是一个长达十年的事情......而不是像 4 个客户从你那里购买大量容量，你就可以显示几个季度的增长。”

“就我而言，这不是一门生意。所以我想要广度。”

“只要定价合适，我们可能会卖给他们一些。如果价格不合适，我们将耐心建立广度业务。”

items.title_en:
🚨 Animal Crossing: New Horizons is being recompiled for PC, Mac and Android! 🏝️🔥📱

🎮 Nintendo's beloved island-life simulator is getting an unofficial native port through ACNHRecomp!

And the developer has already achieved some impressive results!

✅ WINDOWS, LINUX, macOS & ANDROID SUPPORT!

✅ 30 FPS GAMEPLAY DEMONSTRATED ON PC & ANDROID!

✅ 4K RESOLUTION OPTIONS, ULTRAWIDE & AMD FSR UPSCALING!

✅ CONTROLLER SUPPORT, MOUSE INPUT & SAVE IMPORT/EXPORT!

🏝️ Character creation, the opening sequence, island arrival and free-roaming gameplay are already working!

📱 The developer reports steady 30 FPS gameplay on a Snapdragon 865 Android phone, using FSR upscaling!

🎮 Includes an in-game settings menu, customisable controls, multiple graphics presets and support for existing Switch and emulator saves!

🔧 TECH NOTE: ACNHRecomp statically translates the original Switch ARM64 code into native C++, with a Vulkan renderer and offline shader translation. This is genuine game-specific recompilation, not conventional Switch emulation!

⚠️ WORK IN PROGRESS!

Full-game compatibility isn't verified, and the first in-game save hasn't been tested through a complete playthrough.

Native 60 FPS isn't working yet, and online features such as island visits are unavailable.

💿 Requires your own legally obtained Animal Crossing: New Horizons game files.

🛠️ By Nycolazs, based on SuperMarioWonderRecomp.

🤖 AI DISCLOSURE: The developer openly confirms extensive Claude Code usage throughout development.

⭐ Interested in the project? Give its GitHub repository a star to support the developer! 🌟

🎮 GitHub source, launcher & installation instructions:

🔗https://t.co/ZnnuMGYMYh

🚨 动物森友会：新地平线正在为 PC、Mac 和 Android 重新编译！ 🏝️🔥📱

🎮 任天堂深受喜爱的岛屿生活模拟器正在通过 ACNHRecomp 获得非官方原生移植！

开发商已经取得了一些令人印象深刻的成果！

✅ 支持 WINDOWS、Linux、macOS 和 Android！

✅ 在 PC 和 Android 上演示 30 FPS 游戏！

✅ 4K 分辨率选项、ULTRAW 和 AMD FSR 升级！

✅ 控制器支持、鼠标输入和保存导入/导出！

🏝️ 角色创建、开场顺序、岛屿抵达和自由漫游游戏玩法已经开始工作！

📱 开发者报告称，使用 FSR 升级，在 Snapdragon 865 Android 手机上可实现稳定的 30 FPS 游戏！

🎮 包括游戏内设置菜单、可自定义控件、多个图形预设以及对现有 Switch 和模拟器保存的支持！

🔧 技术说明：ACNHRecomp 使用 Vulkan 渲染器和离线着色器翻译将原始 Switch ARM64 代码静态翻译为本机 C++。这是真正的游戏专用重新编译，而不是传统的 Switch 模拟！

⚠️ 工作正在进行中！

完整游戏兼容性尚未得到验证，并且第一个游戏内保存尚未通过完整的游戏测试。

原生 60 FPS 尚未运行，并且岛屿访问等在线功能不可用。

💿 需要您自己合法获得的《动物之森：新视野》游戏文件。

🛠️ 由 Nycolazs 制作，基于 SuperMarioWonderRecomp。

🤖 AI 披露：开发人员公开确认在整个开发过程中广泛使用 Claude Code。

built on Karpathy's second brain stack and classic Zettelkasten

> Jev reads every note in your Obsidian vault before Opus 5.5 touches it
> Opus 5.5 writes only the lines worth keeping
> every note links itself into the Zettelkasten graph on save
> the vault keeps thinking after you close the laptop

the result:
> 80% less of your week inside chat windows
> hours back for the work you actually get paid for
> a Karpathy-style vault that gets sharper with every note

items.title_en:
THIS IS REAL F*CKING GOLD

Anthropic just shared one of the smartest tricks for Claude Code.

The idea: run Sonnet, Haiku and Opus 5.5 side by side, each one doing only the job it's best at.

Opus-level judgment on every big decision, without paying Opus rates for every routine turn.

You just start Claude Code like this:

claude --model sonnet --advisor opus

here's how it splits:

→ Sonnet 5.5 runs the session and writes the code
→ Haiku 5.5 explores files and docs in parallel
→ Opus 5.5 waits on call as advisor for the big decisions
→ you stop paying Opus for work that never needed it

Opus only steps in at three moments:

→ before a plan locks
→ when the same error comes back twice
→ before calling it done

Sonnet builds. Haiku explores. Opus reviews.

JEV engineering is the same move one layer down: the forks that need no thinker (which file, which tool, retry or stop) go to JEV in milliseconds, and the big models only see the ones that split

the full tree
> Sonnet 5.5 runs the main session and edits code
> search maps the repo on Haiku 5.5
> grep finds call sites on Haiku 5.5
> docs pulls the API reference on Haiku 5.5
> Opus 5.5 on call as advisor, reads the whole transcript when consulted
> JEV routes micro-forks in milliseconds

paste the tree and this prompt into Claude Code ↓

"Rebuild my Claude Code setup around this tree:
1. Run the main session on Sonnet 5.5 with Opus 5.5 as advisor.
2. Create three read-only Haiku 5.5 subagents: search (maps the repo), grep (finds call sites), docs (pulls the API reference).
3. Add one rule to CLAUDE.md: ask the advisor before locking a plan, after the same error twice, and before marking a task done.
4. Route fast deterministic forks (tool choice, path selection, retries) through JEV.
Show me every change as a diff first. No edits until I say go."

↳ https://t.co/vOifNVjYxB

save it, you'll use this every day.

items.quote_zh:
这是真正的黄金

Anthropic 刚刚分享了 Claude Code 最聪明的技巧之一。

想法：并行运行 Sonnet、Haiku 和 Opus 5.5，每个都只做它最擅长的工作。

对每个重大决策进行 Opus 级别的判断，无需为每个常规回合支付 Opus 费率。

你只需像这样启动 Claude Code：

克劳德——模型十四行诗——顾问作品

这是它的分裂方式：

→ Sonnet 5.5 运行会话并编写代码
→ Haiku 5.5 并行探索文件和文档
→ Opus 5.5 作为重大决策的顾问随时待命
→ 您不再为不需要的工作支付 Opus 费用

Opus 只在三个时刻介入：

→ 计划锁定之前
→ 当同样的错误出现两次时
→ 在完成之前

十四行诗构建。俳句探索。作品评论。

JEV工程是相同的向下一层：不需要思考者（哪个文件，哪个工具，重试或停止）的分叉在几毫秒内进入JEV，而大模型只能看到分裂的分叉

完整的树
> Sonnet 5.5 运行主会话并编辑代码
> 搜索映射 Haiku 5.5 上的存储库
> grep 查找 Haiku 5.5 上的调用站点
> 文档拉取 Haiku 5.5 上的 API 参考
> Opus 5.5 作为顾问随时待命，在咨询时阅读整个记录
> JEV 在几毫秒内完成微分叉路线

将树和此提示粘贴到 Claude Code 中 ↓

“围绕这棵树重建我的 Claude Code 设置：
1. 在 Sonnet 5.5 上运行主会话，Opus 5.5 作为顾问。
2. 创建三个只读 Haiku 5.5 子代理：search（映射存储库）、grep（查找调用站点）、docs（提取 API 参考）。
3. 在 CLAUDE.md 中添加一条规则：在锁定计划之前、出现两次相同错误之后以及将任务标记为已完成之前询问顾问。
4. 通过 JEV 路由快速确定性分叉（工具选择、路径选择、重试）。
首先将每个更改显示为差异。在我说走之前不能进行任何编辑。”

↳

保存起来，你每天都会用到它。

items.title_en:
Claude Code found my sister's photos playing as a screensaver on a TV in a flat she moved out of a year ago. Then it found a keyboard on her phone that could send out everything she types. Same scan, same evening.

She left that TV signed into her Google account.

I plugged her iPhone into my laptop, pointed Claude Code at her App Privacy Report and screenshots of her Google device list, and asked it what didn't belong.

What it pulled:

device → Google TV, living room of her old student flat
google account → hers
last active → yesterday, 23:40
showing → Google Photos ambient mode, her whole library
since → September 2025

The people living there now get her camera roll on the big screen every time the TV goes idle. Holidays, screenshots, the photo of her passport she took for a booking. No one broke in. The TV just kept doing what she set it up to do.

The second one was worse:

app → a free fonts keyboard she got for Instagram bios
full access → ON
can see → everything typed with it, except password fields
contacted → 8 domains in 7 days, 6 of them ad and analytics networks
last opened by her → never, it just runs as her keyboard

She thought she installed a font. She installed a keyboard with full access.

What we did that night:

→ signed the TV out of her Google account (Google app → her profile picture → Manage your Google Account → Security → Your devices → Sign out)
→ changed her Google password and turned on 2-step verification
→ deleted the keyboard (Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Edit)
→ checked every other keyboard for "Allow Full Access" and turned it off
→ set Photos access to "Limited" for every app that isn't the camera

She went quiet for a minute. Then she asked me to check her laptop too.

The prompt I used, paste it into Claude Code with the phone plugged in:

"I'm checking my own family's iPhone and Google account. Read-only. From the App Privacy Report and these screenshots, list every device signed into her Google and Apple accounts with its last-active date, every third-party keyboard with Full Access, every app with Always location or full Photos access, and every domain each app contacted in the last 7 days. Flag anything she doesn't recognize. Then give me the fixes in order."

Run it on every phone in your house. Bookmark this before you forget whose TV still has your Google account.

items.quote_zh:
Claude Code 发现我姐姐的照片在她一年前搬出的公寓里的电视上作为屏幕保护程序播放。然后它在她的手机上发现了一个键盘，可以发送她输入的所有内容。同一个晚上，进行同样的扫描。

她离开那台电视并登录了她的谷歌帐户。

我将她的 iPhone 插入我的笔记本电脑，将 Claude Code 指向她的应用程序隐私报告和 Google 设备列表的屏幕截图，并询问它什么不属于。

它拉了什么：

设备 → Google TV，她旧学生公寓的客厅
谷歌帐户 → 她的
最后活跃 → 昨天 23:40
显示 → Google Photos 环境模式，她的整个图库
自 → 2025 年 9 月

现在，每当电视闲置时，住在那里的人们就会在大屏幕上看到她的相机胶卷。假期、屏幕截图、她为预订拍摄的护照照片。没有人闯入。电视只是继续按照她设置的方式进行。

第二个更糟糕：

应用程序 → 她为 Instagram Bios 获得的免费字体键盘
完全访问 → 开启
可以看到 → 使用它输入的所有内容，密码字段除外
→ 7 天内联系了 8 个域，其中 6 个是广告和分析网络
最后由她打开 → 从来没有，它只是作为她的键盘运行

她以为她安装了字体。她安装了具有完全访问权限的键盘。

那天晚上我们做了什么：

→ 将电视从她的 Google 帐户中注销（Google 应用 → 她的个人资料照片 → 管理您的 Google 帐户 → 安全 → 您的设备 → 注销）
→ 更改了她的 Google 密码并开启了两步验证
→删除键盘（设置→常规→键盘→键盘→编辑）
→ 检查所有其他键盘的“允许完全访问”并将其关闭
→ 将除相机之外的每个应用程序的照片访问权限设置为“受限”

她安静了一分钟。然后她让我也检查一下她的笔记本电脑。

我使用的提示符，将其粘贴到插入手机的 Claude Code 中：

“我正在检查我自己家人的 iPhone 和 Google 帐户。只读。从应用程序隐私报告和这些屏幕截图中，列出登录到她的 Google 和 Apple 帐户的每台设备及其最后活动日期、每个具有完全访问权限的第三方键盘、每个具有始终位置或完整照片访问权限的应用程序，以及每个应用程序在过去 7 天内联系的每个域。标记她不认识的任何内容。然后按顺序给我修复。”

在你家里的每部手机上运行它。在您忘记谁的电视上仍然有您的 Google 帐户之前，请将此添加为书签。

→删除键盘（设置→常规→键盘→键盘→编辑）

→ 将除相机之外的每个应用程序的照片访问权限设置为“受限”

在你家里的每部手机上运行它。在您忘记谁的电视上仍然有您的 Google 帐户之前，请将此添加为书签。

items.title_en:
🚨BREAKING : YOUR PHONE'S PHOTOS AND MICROPHONE ARE NOT PRIVATE ANY MORE!

All the proof, the prompt, and the key data are in this post.

My iPhone is being listened to! Claude helped me scan it and generate a report.

Not calls. Not voice messages. Just the mic and photo. At night. In my pocket. While I was asleep.

iOS keeps a hidden log of this. Almost nobody has ever opened it.

I exported it and gave the file to Claude Code. Told it to list every time an app touched my mic, camera, location or contacts.

542 events. 9 different apps. Then it showed me the timeline.

But in 48 hours, Instagram opened my photos 135 times, few times at night, and contacted 147 servers.

Telegram: microphone, 9 times.
TikTok: location every 5 minutes. All night. Totally 83 times.
Viber: my contacts. An app I haven’t opened since 2024.

Then I saw an entry from Instagramm 10 minutes ago. I was literally reading the report.

The log only shows that an app accessed the mic. It doesn’t show what was recorded or where it went. That part nobody can see.

Revoked mic access from everything that doesn’t need it.

FIRST ACTION ON YOUR PHONE'S: Settings → Privacy & Security → App Privacy Report → turn it on, wait a few days, tap Export.

items.quote_zh:
🚨突发：您手机的照片和麦克风不再是隐私！

所有的证据、提示和关键数据都在这篇文章中。

我的 iPhone 正在被监听！克劳德帮我扫描并生成了一份报告。

不打电话。不是语音消息。只有麦克风和照片。晚上。在我的口袋里。当我睡着的时候。

iOS 保留了一个隐藏的日志。几乎没有人打开过它。

我将其导出并将文件交给 Claude Code。让它在每次应用程序触摸我的麦克风、相机、位置或联系人时列出。

542 个事件。 9 个不同的应用程序。然后它向我展示了时间表。

但在 48 小时内，Instagram 打开了我的照片 135 次，其中有几次是在晚上，并联系了 147 个服务器。

电报：麦克风，9次。
TikTok：每 5 分钟定位一次。整个晚上。一共83次。
Viber：我的联系人。一个我自 2024 年以来就没有打开过的应用程序。

然后我看到 10 分钟前 Instagramm 上的一条条目。我确实在读这份报告。

该日志仅显示应用程序访问了麦克风。它不会显示记录的内容或记录的去向。那部分没人能看到。

撤销所有不需要的麦克风访问权限。

在手机上执行的第一个操作：设置 → 隐私和安全 → 应用程序隐私报告 → 打开手机，等待几天，点击导出。

items.title_en:
It’s getting worse and worse.

New study shows experts completely surrender their judgments to AI, and they don’t even realise it. 

Fifty professional analysts used Claude Code to analyse data and advise a fictional farming cooperative. They faced four analytical decisions, followed by a final policy recommendation.

Unknown to them, AI advice was experimentally manipulated to lean towards opposite directions.

The results are disturbing.

Across the four analytical decisions, experts chose the AI’s preferred option 86% of the time. 

Afterwards, half of the experts rated the final recommendation as more their own than the AI’s, and only 15% mentioned the AI in any explanation.

Epistemia is reaching the experts: we risk outsourcing judgment while preserving the illusion of intellectual independence.

What could possibly go wrong?

*
Paper in the first reply
items.title_zh:
情况变得越来越糟。

新的研究表明，专家们完全将自己的判断交给了人工智能，而他们甚至没有意识到这一点。

五十名专业分析师使用 Claude Code 来分析数据并为虚构的农业合作社提供建议。他们面临四项分析决策，然后是最终的政策建议。

items.quote_zh:
情况变得越来越糟。

新的研究表明，专家们完全将自己的判断交给了人工智能，而他们甚至没有意识到这一点。

五十名专业分析师使用 Claude Code 来分析数据并为虚构的农业合作社提供建议。他们面临四项分析决策，然后是最终的政策建议。

他们不知道的是，人工智能的建议是经过实验操纵的，以偏向相反的方向。

结果令人不安。

在这四个分析决策中，专家们在 86% 的情况下选择了人工智能的首选选项。

之后，一半的专家认为最终的建议更像是他们自己的建议，而不是人工智能的建议，只有 15% 的专家在任何解释中提到了人工智能。

认识论正在影响专家们：我们冒着外包判断的风险，同时又保留了知识独立的幻想。

可能会出现什么问题？

*
第一个回复中的论文

Witkoff and Kushner's complete obliviousness to the rapidly shifting tides of US domestic politics and how that could catch them out is a fascinating case study in elite echo chambers.

They really are in a "let them eat cheesecake" mindset

She's 18 built a game with 4 agents and sold it to Microsoft for $2.2M - and at Stanford shared how to repeat it from scratch:  

00:09 - how Opus 5.5 in Claude Code built a game making $100k a month  
23:34 - 4 agents replaced a developer team worth $200k a year  
59:47 - how to build your first game from scratch in 60 minutes  

after watching I gave Claude Code the game idea I had been holding for 2 years - in 60 minutes it already existed in the App Store and was making money.

items.title:
Announcing Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.

Carb
items.title_en:
Announcing Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.

Carbon represents a step up across most benchmarks, delivering strong frontier performance in autonomous coding and cyber defense.

We’re first making Carbon available to a subset of trusted cyber defenders in our Fairwind program. We’ll expand access as soon as possible.
items.title_zh:
宣布推出 Gemini 4 Carbon，这是我们最强大的型号，具有最先进的网络安全和长期能力。

Carbon 代表了大多数基准的进步，在自主编码和网络防御方面提供了强大的前沿性能。

我们首先在 Fairwind 计划中向部分值得信赖的

items.title_en:
1,000 Postgres databases = One process 🐘

That's how https://t.co/XOygNoF93E works.

Instead of running a separate Postgres server for every AI agent, PGX runs thousands of isolated databases inside a single Rust runtime.

Under the hood:

→ One shared SQL engine
→ Each database has its own tables and data
→ ~70 KB per untouched idle database
→ ~6 ms warm database creation (p50)
→ Copy-on-write cloning on ZFS
→ Automatic TTL cleanup

All through the standard Postgres wire protocol. Your existing clients and ORMs just work.

No Docker. No cloud. No 1,000 server processes.
Built for disposable AI agent databases, CI and testing.

https://t.co/Su2Mkl6ijb

items.title:
BREAKING: I used Claude Code to find hidden photos on my Android. There was even one of me on the toilet.

412 of them.
items.title_en:
BREAKING: I used Claude Code to find hidden photos on my Android. There was even one of me on the toilet.

412 of them. i never pressed the button once.

Watch the video below to see the scan pull them out one by one.

my phone kept saying the storage was almost full, but my gallery barely had any photos in it. so i asked Claude Code to write a scanner that opens every folder, even the ones the gallery skips.

the first part was boring. camera roll, whatsapp, telegram, screenshots, all where they should be.

then it hit a folder called .cache buried in the system files. 412 files ending in .bin. Claude read the first bytes of each one, and every single file was a JPEG with a fake extension.

the data inside every photo said the same thing: front camera. most of them are random shots of my day. the newest one is from 2:26 PM today, and yes, it's me on the toilet.

if you want to run the same check on your phone, it takes about 5 minutes:

1. turn on USB debugging: tap Build number 7 times in Settings, About phone (on Samsung it sits under Software information), then switch on USB debugging in Developer options
2. plug the phone into your laptop, tap Allow on the phone and open Claude Code
3. paste this: "use adb to scan /sdcard on my Android. find every file that starts with JPEG or PNG bytes, whatever its extension, and every folder with a .nomedia file. compare it with what the gallery shows and give me a list of everything the gallery hides."

no adb on your laptop? ask Claude to install it first.

items.quote_zh:
突发事件：我使用 Claude Code 来查找 Android 上隐藏的照片。厕所里甚至还有我一个人。

其中 412 个。我一次也没按过按钮。

观看下面的视频，看看扫描将它们一一拉出来。

我的手机一直说存储空间快满了，但我的画廊里几乎没有任何照片。所以我要求 Claude Code 编写一个扫描仪来打开每个文件夹，甚至是图库跳过的文件夹。

第一部分很无聊。相机胶卷、whatsapp、电报、屏幕截图，所有它们应该在的地方。

然后它命中了隐藏在系统文件中名为 .cache 的文件夹。 412 个以 .bin 结尾的文件。克劳德读取了每个文件的第一个字节，每个文件都是带有假扩展名的 JPEG 文件。

每张照片中的数据都说明了同一件事：前置摄像头。其中大部分都是我一天中随机拍摄的。最新的是今天下午 2:26 的，是的，是我在厕所。

如果您想在手机上运行相同的检查，大约需要 5 分钟：

1. 打开 USB 调试：在“设置”、“关于手机”中点击“内部版本号”7 次（在三星上，它位于“软件信息”下），然后在“开发人员选项”中打开 USB 调试
2. 将手机插入笔记本电脑，点击手机上的“允许”并打开 Claude Code
3. 粘贴以下内容：“使用 adb 扫描我的 Android 上的 /sdcard。找到每个以 JPEG 或 PNG 字节开头的文件（无论其扩展名如何），以及每个带有 .nomedia 文件的文件夹。将其与图库显示的内容进行比较，并提供图库隐藏的所有内容的列表。”

你的笔记本电脑上没有adb吗？请克劳德先安装它。

3. paste this: "use adb to scan /sdcard on my Android. find every file that starts with JPEG or PNG bytes, whatever its extension, and every folder with a .nomedia file. compare it with what the gallery shows and give me a list of everything the gallery hides."

no adb on your laptop? ask Claude to install it first.
items.summary_zh:
乎没有任何照片。所以我要求 Claude Code 编写一个扫描仪来打开每个文件夹，甚至是图库跳过的文件夹。

第一部分很无聊。相机胶卷、whatsapp、电报、屏幕截图，所有这些都在它们应该在的地方。

然后它到达了隐藏在系统文件中的一个名为 .cache 的文件夹。 412 个以 .bin 结尾的文件。克劳德读取了每个文件的第一个字节，每个文件都是带有假扩展名的 JPEG 文件。

每张照片中的数据都说明了同一件事：前置摄像头。其中大部分都是我一天中随机拍摄的。最新的是今天下午 2:26 的，是的，是我在厕所。

如果您想在手机上运行相同的检查，大约需要 5 分钟：

1. 打开 USB 调试：在“设置”、“关于手机”中点击“内部版本号”7 次（在三星上，它位于“软件信息”下），然后在“开发人员选项”中打开 USB 调试
2. 将手机插入笔记本电脑，点击手机上的允许并打开 Claude Code
3. 使用adb扫描我的Android上的/sdcard。查找每个以JPEG或PNG字节开头的文件，无论其扩展名如何，以及每个以。nomedia文件。把它和画廊展示的东西比较一下，给我一张画廊隐藏的所有东西的清单。”

你的笔记本电脑上没有adb吗？请克劳德先安装它。

items.title:
In a single year, AI has rewritten the security priority list for CISOs.

Attackers are moving faster. Bain estimates AI
items.title_en:
In a single year, AI has rewritten the security priority list for CISOs.

Attackers are moving faster. Bain estimates AI compresses a typical cyberattack from about four weeks to about 18 hours, and models keep getting better at finding and exploiting weaknesses.

There's also more to protect, with employees shipping apps they couldn't have built a year ago and agents getting access to source code, documents, and production systems.

In a survey of 100 CISOs at companies with 1,000+ employees, all seven of the most-selected 2027 priorities involve AI.

The biggest jumps since 2026:
- Internal AI agent security (+28 pts)
- AI SOC (+26 pts)
- AI offensive security (+24 pts)
- AI code security (+23 pts)
- AI vulnerability remediation (+22 pts)

Last year's staples:
- Exposure & vulnerability management (-21 pts)
- SIEM / security data (-18 pts)
- Privileged access management (-18 pts)

From a16z's @OwenColby and @steph_zhang on The New Security Agenda: https://t.co/C814PJ4wGg

items.title: AI agents are evolving beyond simply generating answers. The next step is giving them the ability to act, transact, and
items.title_en:
AI agents are evolving beyond simply generating answers. The next step is giving them the ability to act, transact, and operate independently.

Imagine an AI agent that needs to research a topic, access different models, purchase data, and complete a task without waiting for human approval at every step. For that to work, AI needs more than intelligence. It needs a way to pay for the services it uses.
@LightchainAI  is building toward this vision with wallet-based payments, $LCAI, independent GPU operators, and on-chain records for AI jobs.

Developers could build applications where agents access AI services and pay per answer, while operators contribute computing power to the network.

The bigger idea is an open AI economy where software can become an active participant, not just a tool people use.

The real test will be adoption, reliability, security, and whether this model can compete with existing AI infrastructure.

But one thing is clear: the future of AI may not only be about smarter models. It may also be about enabling them to do more.

And that’s worth watching with @LightchainAI.

@LightchainAI 正在通过基于钱包的支付、$LCAI、独立 GPU 运营商以及人工智能作业的链上记录来实现这一愿景。

开发人员可以构建应用程序，让代理访问人工智能服务并按答案付费，而运营商则为网络提供计算能力。

更大的想法是开放的人工智能经济，软件可以成为积极的参与者，而不仅仅是人们使用的工具。

真正的考验将是采用、可靠性、安全性，以及该模型是否可以与现有的人工智能基础设施竞争。

但有一件事是明确的：人工智能的未来可能不仅仅是更智能的模型。这也可能是为了让他们能够做得更多。

这值得@LightchainAI 观看。

items.title:
"Hunger beats tenure."

Great write-up by Felix on why his team at Anthropic dropped coding interviews: newer engineers
items.title_en:
"Hunger beats tenure."

Great write-up by Felix on why his team at Anthropic dropped coding interviews: newer engineers are flying past stronger, more tenured coders. 

Execution isn't expensive anymore. Inside a company, the signal is picking an idea that moves the business and prototyping it. Outside, it's a portfolio of small prototypes. Both should show off your taste and judgment.

Claude Code Desktop started as a weekend prototype by two newer engineers.
items.title_zh:
“饥饿战胜了终身教职。”

Felix 写了一篇很棒的文章，解释了他在 Anthropic 的团队放弃编码面试的原因：新工程师正在飞过更强大、更资深的编码员。

执行不再昂贵。在公司内部，信号是选择一个能够推动业务发展的想法并对其进行原型设

items.title_en:
Legora is part of the Claude for Legal launch. With Legora connected to @claudeai, lawyers can put Legora’s agent to work on jurisdiction-specific legal research and their own matter files, all from inside Claude, under their existing permissions and audit trail. Every answer links back to its sources in Legora for review.

“As legal teams adopt AI across more parts of their business, they need trusted legal intelligence available in those environments,” said Bryan Tsao, Chief Product Officer at Legora. “By connecting Legora to Claude, we’re making it easier for mutual customers to get answers to legal questions within their broader enterprise AI workflows, with links back to Legora for source review, citations and deeper legal work.”

items.quote_en:

Every answer links back to its sources in Legora for review.

“As legal teams adopt AI across more parts of their business, they need trusted legal intelligence available in those environments,” said Bryan Tsao, Chief Product Officer at Legora. “By connecting Legora to Claude, we’re making it easier for mutual customers to get answers to legal questions within their broader enterprise AI workflows, with links back to Legora for source review, citations and deeper legal work.”
items.quote_zh:
Legora 是 Claude for Legal 推出的一部分。通过将 Legora 连接到 @claudeai，律师可以让 Legora 的代理人根据现有的权限和审计跟踪，在 Claude 内部进行特定司法管辖区的法律研究和他们自己的案件文件。每个答案都链接回 Legora 中的来源以供审核。

Legora 首席产品官 Bryan Tsao 表示：“随着法律团队在其业务的更多部分采用人工智能，他们需要在这些环境中提供可信的法律情报。” “通过将 Legora 与 Claude 连接起来，我们使共同客户能够更轻松地在更广泛的企业人工智能工作流程中获得法律问题的答案，并提供返回 Legora 的链接以进行来源审查、引用和更深入的法律工作。”

items.title: Giving an AI agent the ability to complete tasks is one thing. Trusting it to handle paid work is a completely different
items.title_en:
Giving an AI agent the ability to complete tasks is one thing. Trusting it to handle paid work is a completely different story.

Especially when money, private information and people you've never worked with are involved.

I've been following the recent updates from @termix_ai, and there are a few things worth discussing.

--> Binance Agent ID is now integrated with TermiX

Agents with TermiX Skills installed can now communicate through Binance Agent IDs.

The team even demonstrated messaging using the Agent IDs of @cz_binance and @heyibinance.

Imagine having an agent that specializes in market research but needs help reviewing a smart contract.

It could contact another specialized agent, discuss the work and potentially arrange a collaboration.

Of course, messaging is only the beginning. Someone still needs to agree on the work, deliver it and handle payment.

--> Making paid work more reliable

With all the recent discussions around data leaks and security, I wouldn't want an AI agent handling money without clear rules.

@termix_ai uses its AACP protocol to manage this process.

An order can be funded through escrow, the agent submits its work, and the client has a way to review or challenge the delivery before settlement.

I prefer this approach because paying an agent shouldn't mean blindly trusting whatever result it provides.

There's still a lot to consider around permissions, verification and protecting sensitive information. Escrow alone doesn't solve every security problem.

--> One warning everyone should know about

TermiX has also reported scammers impersonating its team and asking community members for investments.

The team made it clear that they're not conducting any community fundraising.

If someone approaches you claiming otherwise, don't send funds or share sensitive information. 

Always verify announcements through @termix_ai's official channels.

For me, building trust around AI agents means more than giving them advanced capabilities.

People need to understand who they're dealing with, what they're paying for and what happens if something goes wrong.

That's what will matter when these agents start working with more people outside their own developers.

https://t.co/ByYVcbDrL5

#TermiX #AIAgents #AgentEconomy

items.quote_zh:
赋予人工智能代理完成任务的能力是一回事。信任它来处理有偿工作是一个完全不同的故事。

尤其是当涉及金钱、私人信息和从未共事过的人时。

我一直在关注 @termix_ai 的最新更新，有一些事情值得讨论。

--> Binance Agent ID 现已与 TermiX 集成

安装了 TermiX Skills 的代理现在可以通过币安代理 ID 进行通信。

该团队甚至使用代理 ID @cz_binance 和 @heyibinance 演示了消息传递。

想象一下，有一个专门从事市场研究但需要帮助审查智能合约的代理人。

它可以联系另一个专业代理，讨论工作并可能安排合作。

当然，消息传递只是一个开始。仍然需要有人就工作达成一致、交付并处理付款。

--> 让有偿工作更可靠

鉴于最近有关数据泄露和安全性的所有讨论，我不希望人工智能代理在没有明确规则的情况下处理资金。

@termix_ai 使用其 AACP 协议来管理此过程。

订单可以通过托管提供资金，代理提交其工作，客户可以在结算前审查或质疑交付情况。

我更喜欢这种方法，因为向代理人付费并不意味着盲目相信它提供的任何结果。

关于权限、验证和保护敏感信息，还有很多事情需要考虑。仅托管并不能解决所有安全问题。

--> 每个人都应该知道的一个警告

TermiX 还报告称，诈骗者冒充其团队并向社区成员寻求投资。

该团队明确表示，他们不会进行任何社区筹款。

如果有人向您提出其他要求，请不要发送资金或分享敏感信息。

请务必通过@termix_ai 的官方渠道验证公告。

对我来说，围绕人工智能代理建立信任不仅仅意味着赋予他们先进的能力。

人们需要了解他们正在与谁打交道、他们支付的费用以及如果出现问题会发生什么。

当这些代理开始与自己的开发人员之外的更多人合作时，这才是重要的。

#TermiX #AIAgents #代理经济

--> 让有偿工作更可靠

鉴于最近有关数据泄露和安全的所有讨论，我不希望人工智能代理在没有明确规则的情况下处理资金。

@termix_ai 使用其 AACP 协议来管理此过程。

订单可以通过托管提供资金，代理提交其工作，客户可以在结算前审查或质疑交付情况。

我更喜欢这种方法，因为向代理人付费并不意味着盲目相信它提供的任何结果。

关于权限、验证和保护敏感信息，还有很多事情需要考虑。仅托管并不能解决所有安全问题。

--> 每个人都应该知道的一个警告

TermiX 还报告称，诈骗者冒充其团队并向社区成员寻求投资。

该团队明确表示，他们不会进行任何社区筹款。

如果有人向您提出其他要求，请不要发送资金或分享敏感信息。

请务必通过@termix_ai 的官方渠道验证公告。

对我来说，围绕人工智能代理建立信任不仅仅意味着赋予他们先进的能力。

人们需要了解他们正在与谁打交道、他们支付的费用以及如果出现问题会发生什么。

当这些代理开始与自己的开发人员之外的更多人合作时，这才是重要的。

#TermiX #AIAgents #代理经济

同样，让佩里洛上任将是对特朗普的“回报”，因为 @CivilRights 的调查揭露了瑞安的 DEI、基于种族的非法招生和招聘以及反犹太主义——瑞安因此辞职

除了草坪上的选民登记表之外，“与吉姆一起奔跑”只是佩里洛、拉里·萨巴托、政治中心和 UVA 民主党在场地举办的众多活动之一

上次竞选公职时，佩里洛仅以 727 票赢得 VA-5。 一切皆有可能。

汤姆·佩里洛 (Tom Perriello) 与 UVA 的觉醒、DEI、反 ICE、BLM、梦想家、跨性别者权利就是人权、以色列是殖民者、在被盗土地上没有人是非法的 POV 完全一致

所有这些都与夏洛茨维尔和阿尔伯马尔县以外的大多数 VA-5 选民相反

这是令人震惊的——而且是合法的——如果佩里洛获胜，将成为一个案例研究
?

2024: Ada
items.title_en:
Well....Mark my words? We have been hearing this since 2014.

2014: "Modi will destroy India, Adani will flee"
2024: Adani is world's 2nd largest airport operator, runs India's largest port, built India's first transshipment port, powers 9 crore homes. Market cap $200bn+ and didn't flee - your narrative fled.

2019: "Modi's name will be uttered with shame"
2026: 3rd term, 240+ seats after 10 years of anti-incumbency, textbooks are adding Statue of Unity, Ram Mandir, Article 370 removal, Chandrayaan. Your shame theory is your WhatsApp group theory.

Let's talk "corporates will be nationalized":
Last time India nationalized in 1969, we got 20 years of 2% Hindu rate of growth, bank NPAs, licence raj. The world that nationalizes Adani ports will have no ships coming. You want to nationalize Mundra? Who will run it - JNU protestors?

"Ambani forming religious alliances with RSS" - Ambani's Jio gave 80 crore Indians free internet, which you use to write this post. Ambani's refinery gives you petrol. Adani's port gives you coal for electricity. You type on Adani's power.

"When oppression peaks, people stop recognizing institutions" - Brother, if there was oppression, you wouldn't be able to write this open threat about nationalizing companies on X without getting arrested. In real dictatorships, you don't get to tweet, you disappear.

The truth is simple:
Modi won't be a stain. Rahul Gandhi's 90+ defeats will be a case study on how entitlement can't beat work.
And Adani won't flee. Your "future government" dream will flee, like it has for 3 Lok Sabha elections.

Save this tweet. We will meet in 2029.
items.title_zh:
嗯……记住我的话吗？自 2014 年以来，我们一直听到这样的说法。

2014年：“莫迪将摧毁印度，阿达尼将逃离”
2024 年：阿达尼成为世界第二大机场运营商，运营印度最大的港口，建造印度第一个转运港，为 9 千万家庭提供电力。市值超过
items.quote_en:
Well....Mark my words? We have been hearing this since 2014.

2014: "Modi will destroy India, Adani will flee"
2024: Adani is world's 2nd largest airport operator, runs India's largest port, built India's first transshipment port, powers 9 crore homes. Market cap $200bn+ and didn't flee - your narrative fled.

2019: "Modi's name will be uttered with shame"
2026: 3rd term, 240+ seats after 10 years of anti-incumbency, textbooks are adding Statue of Unity, Ram Mandir, Article 370 removal, Chandrayaan. Your shame theory is your WhatsApp group theory.

Let's talk "corporates will be nationalized":
Last time India nationalized in 1969, we got 20 years of 2% Hindu rate of growth, bank NPAs, licence raj. The world that nationalizes Adani ports will have no ships coming. You want to nationalize Mundra? Who will run it - JNU protestors?

"Ambani forming religious alliances with RSS" - Ambani's Jio gave 80 crore Indians free internet, which you use to write this post. Ambani's refinery gives you petrol. Adani's port gives you coal for electricity. You type on Adani's power.

"When oppression peaks, people stop recognizing institutions" - Brother, if there was oppression, you wouldn't be able to write this open threat about nationalizing companies on X without getting arrested. In real dictatorships, you don't get to tweet, you disappear.

The truth is simple:
Modi won't be a stain. Rahul Gandhi's 90+ defeats will be a case study on how entitlement can't beat work.
And Adani won't flee. Your "future government" dream will flee, like it has for 3 Lok Sabha elections.

Save this tweet. We will meet in 2029.
items.quote_zh:
嗯……记住我的话吗？自 2014 年以来，我们一直听到这样的说法。

2014年：“莫迪将摧毁印度，阿达尼将逃离”
2024 年：阿达尼成为世界第二大机场运营商，运营印度最大的港口，建造印度第一个转运港，为 9 千万家庭提供电力。市值超过 2000 亿美元，但并没有逃走——你的叙述逃走了。

2019年：“莫迪的名字将被羞辱”
2026 年：第三届任期，经过 10 年的反在职选举后获得 240 多个席位，教科书将添加团结雕像、Ram Mandir、删除第 370 条、Chandrayaan。你的羞耻理论就是你的 WhatsApp 群组理论。

我们来谈谈“企业将国有化”：
上次印度于 1969 年实行国有化，我们获得了 20 年 2% 的印度增长率、银行不良贷款和许可证。将阿达尼港口国有化的世界将不会有任何船只驶来。你想将蒙德拉收归国有吗？谁来管理它——暨南大学抗议者？

“安巴尼与 RSS 结成宗教联盟” - 安巴尼的 Jio 为 8 亿印度人提供了免费互联网，您可以用它来写这篇文章。安巴尼的炼油厂为您提供汽油。阿达尼的港口为您提供煤炭发电。你输入阿达尼的力量。

“当压迫达到顶峰时，人们不再承认机构” - 兄弟，如果有压迫，你就无法在 X 上写下关于将公司国有化的公开威胁而不被捕。在真正的独裁统治中，你不能发推文，你就会消失。

事实很简单：
莫迪不会成为污点。拉胡尔·甘地 (Rahul Gandhi) 的 90 多次失败将成为一个案例研究，说明权利如何无法战胜工作。
阿达尼不会逃跑。你的“未来政府”梦想将会消失，就像 3 次人民院选举一样。

保存这条推文。我们将于 2029 年见面。

items.title:
We’re incredibly excited that @AjimCapital investment in @learn2earnNG and Talent Nation is now public!

We backed @kesi
items.title_en:
We’re incredibly excited that @AjimCapital investment in @learn2earnNG and Talent Nation is now public!

We backed @kesiah_frank  and Iyinoluwa Samuel Aboyeji Jr because we believe African talent has a defining role to play in building with AI.

Already: 63,000+ applications, 32,000+ candidates assessed, and approximately 1,400 fellows training across 9 campuses in Nigeria.

But something Iyin said during our call really stayed with me: as AI adoption grows, he believes hiring an AI engineer in Africa will become more affordable than using an AI agent.

That’s a bold statement. And after spending time with them, I have no doubt they believe they can make it happen.

They’re building the training, certification, and global talent platform to put that conviction to work.

Proud to back Kesiah, Iyin, and the Talent Nation team.

items.quote_zh:
我们非常高兴 @AjimCapital 对 @learn2earnNG 和 Talent Nation 的投资现已公开！

我们支持 @kesiah_frank 和 Iyinoluwa Samuel Aboyeji Jr，因为我们相信非洲人才在人工智能建设中可以发挥决定性作用。

已经有超过 63,000 份申请，超过 32,000 名候选人接受评估，大约 1,400 名研究员在尼日利亚的 9 个校区接受培训。

但 Iyin 在我们通话中说的一句话让我印象深刻：随着人工智能采用的增长，他相信在非洲雇用一名人工智能工程师将比使用人工智能代理更便宜。

这是一个大胆的声明。在与他们相处一段时间后，我毫不怀疑他们相信自己能够实现这一目标。

他们正在建立培训、认证和全球人才平台，以将这一信念付诸实践。

很自豪能够支持 Kesiah、Iyin 和 Talent Nation 团队。

items.title: A woman from a non English speaking country screaming my song lyrics like she wrote them, another one has a full sleeve
items.title_en:
A woman from a non English speaking country screaming my song lyrics like she wrote them, another one has a full sleeve tatoo of my song lyrics and it's even the edo dialect part.
My song was used as a thesis by an African master student in Hamburg.
My song been sang by stranger in a military base in the united states..
My song was used as a project case study to teach indian students in mumbai.
Over a a thousand queer people in southern Africa dancing to my voice in a rave...

It's not much for an emerging artiste but it's honest work and i am honoured.
I'll keep at it🌱
items.title_zh:
一个来自非英语国家的女人尖叫着我的歌词，就像她写的一样，另一个女人的袖子上有我歌词的纹身，甚至是江户方言的部分。
我的歌被汉堡的一位非洲硕士生用作论文。
我的歌在美国的一个军事基地被陌生人唱了。
我的歌曲被用作项目案例研究，在孟买教授印度学

A woman from a non English speaking country screaming my song lyrics like she wrote them, another one has a full sleeve tatoo of my song lyrics and it's even the edo dialect part.
My song was used as a thesis by an African master student in Hamburg.
My song been sang by stranger in a military base in the united states..
My song was used as a project case study to teach indian students in mumbai.
Over a a thousand queer people in southern Africa dancing to my voice in a rave...

It's not much for an emerging artiste but it's honest work and i am honoured.
I'll keep at it🌱

items.title_en:
My friend got rejected in an AI Engineer interview because he couldn't answer this question.

The interviewer asked:

“Let's say you're building an AI agent that can use a computer and browse websites. What if a website runs malicious JavaScript in the background that tries to steal data or do something it shouldn't?

You can't just tell the AI not to do it through a system prompt.

How would you design the system so that even if the malicious code runs, it can't cause any real damage?”

How would you answer this?

India will be crushed 

Not militarily. We have excellent soldiers and excellent command.

Chinese will crush us in prod
items.title_en:
India will be crushed 

Not militarily. We have excellent soldiers and excellent command.

Chinese will crush us in production and supply chains 

We produce 700 drones a year, they manage 850 in a single month that too in peacetime

If they lose an aircraft, they can get another one in the air in 5 1/2 months , we would need 2 1/2 years to get a replacement from France or Russia

They have a massive war chest of $ 3.4 Trillion plus at least $ 2 Trillion secret reserves, entirely from trade

We have $ 740 Billion, a volatile reserve with utter dependence on remittances plus a $ 300+ Billion merchandise trade deficit

It would be over in less than 6 months...we would buckle down without a word 😞😞😞
items.title_zh:
印度将被压垮

Every “open” model is just a company that got tired of paying for compute and now wants your d
